articles.body:
The **Coalition** (tag **Coa**; called "The 1st Coalition" in the community Timeline document) was a Wynncraft war alliance active from October 2017 to February 2018. Founded by [[Kingdom Foxes]], KingdomPhoenixes, Gilded Sparrows and House of Sentinels, it conquered the entire territory map by the end of 2017, and its fracture in February 2018 produced both [[Alliance Alliance]] and [[the-federation|the Federation]] — the two sides of the [[coalition-civil-war|Coalition Civil War]].

## History

### Rise to map dominance
The Coalition was founded in October 2017 by four guilds: Kingdom Foxes, KingdomPhoenixes, Gilded Sparrows and House of Sentinels. It took control of the Wynn Province on 23 Nov 2017, and on Christmas Day 2017 it wiped War Syndicate — "they wiped ws off the map on Christmas day," as one participant recalled in a 2020 retrospective — gaining full map dominance.

### The split
On 16–17 Feb 2018 (the community guild-timeline image dates the split to the 16th, the Timeline document to the 17th), five member guilds — [[HackForums]], [[Paladins United]], House of Sentinels, [[Emorians]] and Kangronomicon — left over map disputes and formed [[Alliance Alliance]] together with [[Fantasy]] and Necronomicon, declaring war on their former alliance and beginning the [[coalition-civil-war|Coalition Civil War]]. The Coalition remnant merged with War Syndicate's remains into the new [[the-federation|Federation]], ending the Coalition as an entity; the civil war itself ran until the Federation took control of the map on 20 Mar 2018.

Even the genealogy was disputed among participants. A 2020 retrospective states plainly that "Coa and WS merged... this was a creation of fed", while Slayne wrote in 2018: "I created Fed because I (along with some others) created Double AA."

### Record caveats
The Coalition predates the territory-exchange record, which begins in January 2018: recorded membership dates are clamped to that boundary, the guilds' real join dates are unrecorded, and the membership of the five departing guilds is inferred from their documented February 2018 departures rather than from recorded joins. The alliance's earlier history survives only in forum accounts.

## Membership
{{alliance:Coalition}}

## Legacy
Both of the great blocs of 2018 descend from the Coalition: Alliance Alliance from its defectors, and the Federation from its remnant. The Federation went on to hold the entire map for nearly nine months, defining the [[federation-era|Federation era]] — and the Coalition's brief, total dominance became the template every later map-holding alliance would be measured against.

## Sources
- Community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ), recovered via Wynncraft forums thread 265297
- Wynncraft forums thread 265297, retrospective posts of Apr 2020 (Lego_DW on the Coa–WS merger; IceResistance on the Christmas Day wipe of War Syndicate)
- Community Timeline document (chronicle research corpus)
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (2018 window boundary)

articles.title: Council of Canyon Kingdoms
articles.summary: The Council of Canyon Kingdoms (CCK or CoCK) was a Wynncraft war alliance of autumn 2019, formed on 15 Sep 2019 by seven guilds of the victorious Terra bloc. It collapsed on 23 Nov 2019 when The Ascendancy bloc departed, two days after Titans Valor and DiamondDeities left.
articles.body:
The **Council of Canyon Kingdoms** (tag **CoCK**, also written CCK) was a Wynncraft war alliance of autumn 2019, formed by the victors of the [[Luna]]–[[Terra]] war and dissolved ten weeks later.

## History

### Formation
The Council formed on 15 Sep 2019, a week after Terra took the map from Luna, by seven guilds of the victorious Terra bloc: [[Kingdom Foxes]], [[DiamondDeities]], [[Titans Valor]], [[The Simple Ones]], [[Fantasy]], Phantom Hearts and Empire of Sindria.

### Course
Phantom Hearts abandoned the Council at an undated point in September–October 2019; the chronicle approximates its exit to 1 Oct, noting that exchange data is inconclusive on the split (Phantom Hearts went on to join [[Artemis]] on 4 Nov). TheNoLifes joined on 28 Sep, BlueStoneGroup on 10 Oct and Vindicator on 14 Oct, bringing the Council to its peak of nine concurrent members. Kingdom Foxes departed on 1 Nov, the eve of [[Terra]]'s formal fall.

### Collapse
The Council collapsed on 23 Nov 2019 after The Ascendancy bloc departed, two days after Titans Valor and DiamondDeities left. The Ascendancy itself — created 27 Apr 2019 per the community timeline — left no recorded roster anywhere. A week later, on 1 Dec, DiamondDeities, Titans Valor and The Simple Ones regrouped as [[Horologium]].

## Membership
{{alliance:Council of Canyon Kingdoms}}

## Legacy
The Council was the first of the short-lived successor blocs that followed the [[the-alliance-wars-of-2019|Alliance Wars of 2019]] — none of Terra's heirs held together for more than a few months, and the map stabilized only with [[Artemis]]'s rise from 30 Oct 2019. Its own direct successor, Horologium, lasted five weeks.

## Sources
- Community Timeline document — founding roster, departures, collapse
- Community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ), via forums thread 265297 — The Ascendancy's creation date
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis — the inconclusive Phantom Hearts exit signal

articles.title: Cucumber Company
articles.summary: Cucumber Company was the war alliance of the great 2022 realignment, merging the ex-Valhalla and ex-Khaos worlds into a fourteen-guild bloc formed for guild Season 5. Its roster, posted to the forum megalist on 26 June 2022, was the last public alliance roster ever; it was archived and renamed 'Smtn else' at the start of Season 8.
articles.body:
**Cucumber Company** was the war alliance of the great 2022 realignment, merging the ex-[[Valhalla]]/[[Vanir]] and ex-[[Khaos]] worlds into a single fourteen-guild bloc. Its roster, posted to the forum megalist on 26 June 2022, is the last public alliance roster ever recorded; the alliance was archived and renamed “Smtn else” at the start of guild Season 8 in autumn 2022.

## History

### Formation
The exact formation date is undocumented. The war between Khaos and the ex-Valhalla guilds was still running in January 2022, and [[titan-times|Titan Times]] vol. 1 (8 May 2022) records “our first season being a part of the new Cucumber Company war alliance” — placing the founding around the start of guild Season 5 in spring 2022. Map data corroborates the merge timing: exchanges between the ex-Khaos and ex-Valhalla guilds flip from war-shaped to ally-shaped trading in May–June 2022.

### The last public roster
On 26 June 2022 a member (TherapueticLiz of Sins of Seedia) posted the full fourteen-guild roster to the [[the-forum-megalist|megalist]]: [[Aequitas]], [[Titans Valor]], [[Avicia]], Blacklisted, KongoBoys, Empire of Sindria, Gang of Fools, [[Kingdom Foxes]], The Clowns, Nefarious Ravens, Sins of Seedia, [[The Aquarium]], Wynn Legacy and [[Profession Heaven]]. Twelve days later the megalist's alliance section was deleted, and no public alliance roster was ever posted again. Independent corroboration survives in software: Titans Valor's Discord bot consumed an alliance-claims feed built on Avicia's site code between April and December 2022 — the two guilds sharing alliance infrastructure exactly in this window.

Membership shifted at the edges. IceBlue Team was a founding member that had left by 12 June 2022; Gang of Fools joined that same month; and Kingdom Foxes' exit is map-dated to around July 2022, when it entered sustained war with bloc guilds. The Fox and Gang of Fools stints should be read cautiously — both appear on the June roster yet fought bloc guilds in adjacent months.

### Rename
At the start of Season 8 (autumn 2022), “Cucumber was archived. The new alliance name is called Smtn else”, per Titan Times vol. 6 — the same issue that records Gang of Fools having “left and betrayed the alliance”. The bloc's history continues under [[smtn elf]].

## Membership
Joins are approximated to the Season 5 boundary; the roster is attested as of 26 June 2022.

{{alliance:Cucumber Company}}

## Legacy
Cucumber Company ended the two-bloc war era of 2021 by absorbing both sides, and its June 2022 roster post became a historical landmark by accident: the deletion of the megalist's alliance section twelve days later marks the start of the [[private-diplomacy-era|private-diplomacy era]], in which alliances ceased to be publicly recorded.

## Sources
- Titan Times vol. 1 (8 May 2022) and vol. 3 (12 Jun 2022)
- Wynncraft forums thread 278112 (“the megalist”), page 8 posts #160 (26 Jun 2022) and #161 (7 Jul 2022)
- titantimes/valor repository commit history (Apr–Dec 2022 alliance-claims feed)
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (merge timing; Kingdom Foxes' exit)

articles.title: Empire of Nemract
articles.summary: The Empire of Nemract was a ceremonial community union of The Simple Ones and Mystic Woods, formed on 17 August 2020. Branded 'The Empire of Nemract | ILQ + Aeu' and headed by an empress with court titles, it ran community events through 2021 before going quiet after August 2021; no dissolution was ever recorded.
articles.body:
**The Empire of Nemract** was a community political union of the guilds [[The Simple Ones]] and Mystic Woods, formed on 17 August 2020. It ran community events through 2021 and then quietly disappears from the record.

## History
The union was formed on 17 August 2020 by The Simple Ones [ILQ] and Mystic Woods. From 30 November 2020 it was branded “The Empire of Nemract | ILQ + Aeu”; the identity of the “Aeu” partner guild cannot be safely established today — the tag resolves to a different, later guild, making the identification unreliable — so the recorded membership remains the two founding guilds. Its empress held court titles (“Empress of Nemract, Queen of Aphelion”), and the Empire hosted community events through 2021.

The record goes quiet after 26 August 2021. No dissolution was ever announced, and the end date in the chronicle marks last attestation only. Map-data analysis is consistent with a quiet persistence: The Simple Ones and Mystic Woods exchanged only about thirty territories across six years — they never fought.

## Membership
{{alliance:Empire of Nemract}}

## Legacy
The Empire of Nemract is the era's clearest example of a small ceremonial community alliance operating alongside — and untouched by — the great war blocs of 2020–2021. Both members continued independently; The Simple Ones went on through [[Valhalla]], [[Vanir]] and later [[smtn elf]], while remaining at peace with its old partner throughout.

## Sources
- community Timeline document (17 Aug 2020 formation)
- Wynncraft forums thread 278123 (“ILQ + Aeu” branding, 30 Nov 2020)
- The Simple Ones guild thread, page 11 (26 Aug 2021, last attestation)
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (exchange counts between the member guilds)

articles.title: Goose
articles.summary: Goose was the war coalition that rose against Artemis's map dominance in the winter of 2020-21: first attested as an unnamed group of anti-Artemis guilds in December 2020, carrying the name Goose by 19 January 2021. It took map control and collapsed together with Artemis on 11 May 2021, splitting into Valhalla and Khaos.
articles.body:
**Goose** was the war coalition that rose against [[Artemis]]'s map dominance in the winter of 2020–21, took map control, and collapsed together with its rival on 11 May 2021. Its documentation is unusual: the coalition is first attested before it had a name, and no complete roster was ever published in one place.

## History

### An unnamed coalition
The earliest record is a conflict thread of 18 December 2020, which lists an unnamed group of anti-Artemis guilds — among them [[Avicia]], [[Emorians]], Eden, Ultra Violet, Bovemists, Diablo and The Dark Phoenix — and, notably, [[Paladins United]] and [[Imperial]], the two surviving founders of Artemis itself. Map-data analysis dates the coalition's coordinated war on the Artemis core to that same December, when quiet-territory exchanges jumped to 913 for the month after months of skirmishing. The [[goose-artemis-war|Goose-Artemis war]] would run for the rest of the coalition's life.

### Named by January 2021
The name Goose enters the written record on 19 January 2021, in a megalist post noting that “TNR (TNI and TNA) are part of Goose” — the earliest recorded use. Who coined the name, and when the coalition formally adopted it, was never written down. Growth continued through the spring: a megalist post of 1 February 2021 records that “BNU(IBT), SHY and TNL are all goose now” — [[ShadowFall]]'s defection from an Artemis leadership seat, alongside IceBlue Team and TheNoLifes. By late March the future [[Khaos]] core ([[Aequitas]], Wheres The Finish, ChinaNumberOne, Eden, joined in April by Fuzzy Spiders) was aboard, and fan-made roster art of 30 March and 6 April 2021 — explicitly partial — depicted twelve member guilds.

On 25 January 2021 Goose and Artemis jointly granted [[Profession Heaven]] neutral status as a public profession-XP guild. Goose took map control from Artemis and held it until 11 May 2021, when both alliances collapsed on the same day — [[the-great-collapse|The Great Collapse]] — splitting into [[Valhalla]] and Khaos.

### What remains unknown
Goose's formation date, internal leadership and full roster were never recorded. Every membership join in the chronicle is a “by” date, assembled from four dated sources. Two guilds from the December 2020 coalition list — “Lily Pad” and “HICH” — cannot be securely matched to any guild in the historical database and are absent from the recorded roster.

## Membership
{{alliance:Goose}}

## Legacy
Goose's split seeded the next era: Valhalla drew on its broad membership while Khaos formed from its core, and the [[valhalla-khaos-war|war between them]] began the day both were founded. The joint protection of Profession Heaven that Goose co-established persisted under successor alliances until 2026.

## Sources
- Wynncraft forums thread 279337 (18 Dec 2020)
- Wynncraft forums thread 278112 (“the megalist”), posts of 19 Jan, 1 Feb and 4 Mar 2021, via Wayback Machine snapshots
- Goose fan-made roster art (30 Mar and 6 Apr 2021)
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (December 2020 war ignition; join dating)

articles.title: Hestia
articles.summary: Hestia was a community (non-war) alliance spanning the rival war blocs of 2020-2022, first attested in December 2020 around Titans Valor, Empire of Sindria, Lux Nova and Paladins United. It declined through 2022, with Adonis founded as its effective successor; its last attestation is from September 2022.
articles.body:
**Hestia** was a community (non-war) alliance that spanned the rival war blocs of 2020–2022. First attested in December 2020 as a four-guild circle around [[Titans Valor]], it survived the collapses of [[Artemis]], [[Goose]], [[Valhalla]] and [[Vanir]] before fading from the record in 2022, with [[Adonis]] founded as its effective successor.

## History
The earliest record of Hestia is a megalist post of 2 December 2020: “ANO is apart of the alliances Hestia (a community alliance between ANO, ESI, LXA, and PUN) and Artemis (war alliance)”. Its founding was never documented; a 6 June 2021 megalist post described it as “about a year old”, placing its formation around mid-2020, and listed six members: Titans Valor, [[Emorians]], Lux Nova, Empire of Sindria, [[Paladins United]] and [[HackForums]].

Hestia's membership cut across the war-alliance lines of its era: in December 2020 Titans Valor was fighting inside Artemis while Paladins United was attested with the opposing coalition that became Goose — yet both belonged to Hestia. As a community alliance it took no recorded part in the wars themselves.

By May 2022 [[titan-times|Titan Times]], Titans Valor's newsletter, described Hestia as declining but “still around”, and recorded [[Adonis]] being founded as a community successor. Paladins United's recruitment thread continued to list Hestia — alongside [[Valkyrie]], “both community alliances” — until 19 September 2022, the alliance's last attestation anywhere. No dissolution was ever recorded.

## Membership
Joins are “by” dates taken from the two attested rosters; the end date marks last attestation, not a recorded dissolution.

{{alliance:Hestia}}

## Legacy
Hestia is one of the clearest examples of its era's split between war and community alliances: its members fought one another under war banners while remaining social allies in Hestia. Its role passed to Adonis, founded around May 2022 by the leaders of Titans Valor and Empire of Sindria, which outlived every war alliance around it.

## Sources
- Wynncraft forums thread 278112 (“the megalist”), posts of 2 Dec 2020 and 6 Jun 2021, via Wayback Machine snapshots
- Titan Times vol. 1 (8 May 2022)
- Paladins United recruitment thread OP, listings Nov 2021 – 19 Sep 2022, via Wayback Machine

articles.title: Horologium
articles.summary: Horologium was a small Wynncraft war alliance formed on 1 Dec 2019 by DiamondDeities, Titans Valor and The Simple Ones — the last regrouping of the Council of Canyon Kingdoms core. It de facto dissolved on 8 Jan 2020 when Nitrogen2Oxygen disbanded DiamondDeities.
articles.body:
**Horologium** (tag **Horo**) was a small, short-lived Wynncraft war alliance at the turn of 2019–2020 — the last regrouping of the [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]] core before that lineage dissolved entirely.

## History
Horologium was formed on 1 Dec 2019 by [[DiamondDeities]], [[Titans Valor]] and [[The Simple Ones]] — three veterans of [[Terra]] and the Council of Canyon Kingdoms, which had collapsed the week before.

Its end came from outside the war map: on 8 Jan 2020, [[Nitrogen2Oxygen]] disbanded DiamondDeities itself, and Horologium de facto dissolved with it. Most of DiamondDeities' remaining members regrouped as Lux Nova the next day. No formal dissolution of the alliance was ever recorded — with one of its three guilds gone, the record simply ends.

## Membership
{{alliance:Horologium}}

## Legacy
Horologium closed the chain of ever-smaller successor blocs descending from Terra. Within the year its survivors resurfaced in the community alliances of 2020: the chronicle records Titans Valor (with Lux Nova) in [[Hestia]], and The Simple Ones in the [[Empire of Nemract]].

## Sources
- Community Timeline document — founding, and the DiamondDeities disbandment of 8 Jan 2020
- Chronicle alliance records (Hestia; Empire of Nemract) — successor memberships

articles.title: Khaos
articles.summary: Khaos was one of the two war alliances born from The Great Collapse of 11 May 2021, formed largely from the core of Goose. It fought the ex-Valhalla guilds for a year — peaking in January 2022 — and was defunct by 26 June 2022, its guilds absorbed into Cucumber Company.
articles.body:
**Khaos** was one of the two war alliances born from [[the-great-collapse|The Great Collapse]] of 11 May 2021, formed largely from the core of [[Goose]]. It fought the ex-[[Valhalla]] guilds for a year and was defunct by 26 June 2022, its guilds absorbed into [[Cucumber Company]].

## History

### Founding
On 11 May 2021 Goose and [[Artemis]] collapsed on the same day. While thirteen guilds formed Valhalla, nine formed Khaos: [[Aequitas]], Wheres The Finish, Nerfuria, Tartarus Wrath, Ultra Violet, Fuzzy Spiders, ChinaNumberOne, Cyphrus Code and Eden — most of them the bloc that had joined Goose in its final spring. Tartarus Wrath was created days after the founding and joined mid-May; Cyphrus Code's stint lasted only until late May, an end inferred from its last territory exchange.

The name itself barely survives in writing: a single megalist post of 25 May 2021 records that “the two major alliances both disbanded and got new names… Valhalla and Kaos”. No public Khaos roster was ever posted — by then alliance rosters lived in a Google Sheet never captured by any archive — and the membership derives from the community Timeline document.

### The war with Valhalla and Vanir
The [[valhalla-khaos-war|Valhalla-Khaos war]] began the day both blocs formed and outlasted Valhalla itself, with [[Vanir]] inheriting the opposing side. TheNoLifes — excluded from Vanir after turning on its Valhalla allies — joined Khaos around December 2021: testimony names it among Khaos's leaders, and map data shows it erupting against the ex-Valhalla guilds that month. The war peaked in January 2022 at 500–800 quiet-territory exchanges per week against an opposing coalition remembered in testimony as “the Pineapple Pact” (a name with no surviving written record), then faded through the spring.

### End
No dissolution was ever announced; the end is a documentary bound. Fighting faded to nothing by mid-July 2022, and when the fourteen-guild Cucumber Company roster was posted to the megalist on 26 June 2022 — explicitly replacing the old alliance listing as incorrect — Khaos was gone, with several of its guilds, Aequitas among them, inside the new bloc.

## Membership
{{alliance:Khaos}}

## Legacy
Khaos was the last opponent of the Valhalla line, and its fade set up the [[the-realignment-era|2022 realignment]]: within months its guilds and their former enemies were trading territory as allies inside Cucumber Company.

## Sources
- community Timeline document (founding roster and dates)
- Wynncraft forums thread 278112 (“the megalist”), post of 25 May 2021 (the name's only written source) and post #160 of 26 Jun 2022 (the “defunct by” bound), via Wayback Machine
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (war curve Jan–Jul 2022; TheNoLifes and Tartarus Wrath dating)
- oral-history testimony (Cameron, TAq veteran): TheNoLifes' leadership role; the “Pineapple Pact” name

articles.title: Luna
articles.summary: Luna was a Wynncraft war alliance of 2019, formed on 14 Feb 2019 to counter SOL. It fought Kingdom Foxes across 300+ territories, gained full map control on 17 Jul 2019 after wiping every guild but Avicia, and collapsed in September 2019 after a leadership revolt and the loss of the map to Terra.
articles.body:
**Luna** was a Wynncraft war alliance of 2019, formed on 14 Feb 2019 to counter [[SOL]]. In five months it went from a counter-bloc to sole master of the territory map — wiping every guild but [[Avicia]] in July — before a leadership revolt and the rise of [[Terra]] destroyed it in September. Its rise and fall form the centrepiece of [[the-alliance-wars-of-2019|the Alliance Wars of 2019]].

## History

### Formation
Luna was formed on 14 Feb 2019 by [[Imperial]], [[Emorians]], Blacklisted, BuildCraftia and others, explicitly to counter SOL, the bloc left standing after [[the-federation|the Federation]]'s fall. The founding list in the community Timeline document is marked as a placeholder, and the record contradicts part of it: contrary to some retellings, exchange data shows [[Kingdom Foxes]] was not a founding member — Luna was at war with Fox from its second day.

### The war on Kingdom Foxes
From 15 Feb 2019 Luna fought Kingdom Foxes across more than 300 territories; Imperial alone attacked Fox 660 times. The war ended when Fox joined Luna on 8 Jul 2019 — the day after the Treaty of Ternaves, in which Fox, [[The Simple Ones]] and ThisIsMurica divided the territory of the dissolved Celestial Tigers.

### Full map control
After fending off an attack on Kingdom Foxes in July 2019, Luna wiped every guild on the map except Avicia; Avicia joined on 17 Jul 2019, and Luna held the entire map.

{{map:2019-07-17|Luna at full map control}}

### Revolt and collapse
On 29 Aug 2019, after a leadership dispute, Emorians and Avicia left Luna and declared war on Imperial, spiralling into a large war over Gavel; ThisIsMurica was kicked the next day for sending fighters, and Terra formed in the chaos on 30 Aug. In the Luna–Terra war of 7–19 Sep 2019, The Simple Ones defected to Terra on 8 Sep and Terra took map control the same day — over 2,000 exchanges swept across 322 territories in ten days. Kingdom Foxes left on the 18th, and Luna collapsed.

## Membership
At its July–August 2019 peak the chronicle records ten member guilds at once.

{{alliance:Luna}}

## Legacy
Luna's fall handed the map to Terra, whose core went on to found the [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]]. The chronicle's [[Valkyrie]] record adds a longer perspective: the long-running Valkyrie network "warred publicly as Luna in 2019" — Luna serving as the war-fighting face of a much older community alliance.

## Sources
- Community Timeline document (chronicle research corpus) — founding, the revolt, the collapse
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis — the war on Kingdom Foxes (660 Imperial attacks), the founding-roster correction, and the Luna–Terra war volumes

articles.title: Niflheim
articles.summary: Niflheim was a community alliance of 2020-2021 whose four attested members — Avicia, IceBlue Team, ShadowFall and TheNoLifes — simultaneously belonged to the era's war blocs. It officially dissolved on 18 December 2021, the same day Vanir collapsed.
articles.body:
**Niflheim** was a community alliance of 2020–2021 that ran alongside — and overlapped with — the war blocs of its day. Its four attested members were simultaneously war-alliance guilds, and it dissolved on 18 December 2021, the same day [[Vanir]] collapsed.

## History
Niflheim's formation was never documented. Its first dated record is [[ShadowFall]]'s join on 27 December 2020. The only attested roster is a megalist post of 7 July 2021 naming the “Niflheim community alliance” as [[Avicia]], Blue Nations United [IBT] (the guild known today as IceBlue Team), ShadowFall and TheNoLifes; the three joins other than ShadowFall's are therefore “by” dates.

All four members belonged to war alliances at the same time — attested in [[Goose]] by February 2021, with three of the four going on to found [[Valhalla]] in May — illustrating the era's layering of community alliances over war blocs. Niflheim itself has no recorded part in any war, and by 2021 the map is so saturated with allied territory-trading that no distinct Niflheim signal can be separated from the surrounding blocs.

Niflheim was officially dissolved on 18 December 2021 — the same day Vanir collapsed.

## Membership
{{alliance:Niflheim}}

## Legacy
Alongside [[Hestia]] and the [[Empire of Nemract]], Niflheim is one of the few community alliances of the era with an attested roster — a reminder that beneath the war-alliance churn of 2020–2021 ran a quieter, more stable social layer.

## Sources
- community Timeline document (ShadowFall join, 27 Dec 2020; official dissolution, 18 Dec 2021)
- Wynncraft forums thread 278112 (“the megalist”), page 8 post #146 (7 Jul 2021)
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (absence of a separable war signal)

articles.title: smtn elf
articles.summary: smtn elf was the final name of the merged super-alliance descended from Cucumber Company: renamed 'Smtn else' at the start of Season 8 (autumn 2022), then 'smtn elf' for Christmas 2022, and never changed back. Sixteen guilds strong at its peak, it died in June 2023 when The Aquarium and Avicia walked out, and by August it had vanished from the record.
articles.body:
**smtn elf** was the final name of the merged super-alliance that dominated Wynncraft warring in 2022–23: [[Cucumber Company]] renamed “Smtn else” at the start of guild Season 8 in autumn 2022, then renamed again to “smtn elf” for Christmas 2022 — and never changed back. It fell apart in June 2023 when [[The Aquarium]] and [[Avicia]] walked out.

## History

### From Cucumber to elf
Per [[titan-times|Titan Times]] vol. 6 (12 October 2022), at the start of Season 8 “Cucumber was archived. The new alliance name is called Smtn else” — the same issue records Gang of Fools having “left and betrayed the alliance” and welcomes [[Paladins United]], [[The Simple Ones]] and TerraLune. The Christmas 2022 rename to “smtn elf” rests on oral-history testimony, corroborated by the name appearing in writing by 17 February 2023 — in a forum thread that dubbed it “unquestionably the greatest super-alliance of 2023” (a tongue-in-cheek thread, but the name and the bloc's scale were real). Because the sources frame Season 8 as a rename rather than a reformation, the chronicle carries the full Cucumber roster through it; only part of that roster is individually re-attested in the smtn-else era.

### 2023
Titan Times vol. 9 (25 March 2023) records the mid-season changes: busted moments joined (a brief stint, over by the end of May), Nefarious Ravens left “on account of the guild disbanding” — its last map exchange was 9 March 2023 — and [[Idiot Co]], which joined that spring, held alliance territory.

### The end
In June 2023 The Aquarium and Avicia quit, rejecting pressure — led by busted moments, per testimony — to shrink their territorial claims: [[the-avocado-split|the Avocado split]]. The alliance's last recorded mention is Avicia's Season 12 post of 10 June 2023 (“To our other allies in smtn elf... thank you for the hqs”); by the Season 13 post of 19 August 2023 it had vanished from the record entirely. No death announcement exists, and map data shows the remaining guilds never fought each other — smtn elf did not break up so much as quietly cease to be.

## Membership
The roster is carried over from Cucumber Company at the Season 8 rename, with the changes attested in Titan Times; joins are approximated to the season boundary.

{{alliance:smtn elf}}

## Legacy
smtn elf was the last of the public super-alliances, and its unannounced death is the [[private-diplomacy-era|private-diplomacy era]] in miniature: no roster, no dissolution notice, just silence between two season posts. Its collapse set up the [[Avocado Aquarium]] pact and the wars that followed.

## Sources
- Titan Times vol. 6 (12 Oct 2022), vol. 8, and vol. 9 (25 Mar 2023)
- Wynncraft forums thread 306790 (17 Feb 2023)
- “SMTN ELSE SLANDER” video by TherapueticLiz (3 Oct 2022)
- Avicia Season 12 post, thread 308780 (10 Jun 2023); Avicia Season 13 post, thread 310286 (19 Aug 2023)
- oral-history testimony (Cameron, TAq veteran): the Christmas rename; the claim-shrinking dispute
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (departure dating; absence of rump infighting)

articles.title: SOL
articles.summary: SOL was the Wynncraft war alliance born from the Federation's ashes in late 2018 — the power Luna was explicitly formed to counter on 14 Feb 2019. Last attested in June 2019, it vanished from the record without a recorded dissolution; no written roster of SOL exists anywhere.
articles.body:
**SOL** was the Wynncraft war alliance born from [[the-federation|the Federation]]'s ashes in late 2018 — a leading power of the winter interregnum and the bloc [[Luna]] was explicitly formed to counter. It is also among the least documented major alliances: no written roster of SOL exists anywhere.

## History

### Creation
SOL was created in the post-collapse chaos following the Federation's fall of 10 Nov 2018; the community timeline records only that "SOL was created at this time." The chronicle approximates its start to about December 2018.

### The war with Luna
On 14 Feb 2019, Luna was formed "as an alliance to counter SOL," and the two blocs fought through the spring as part of [[the-alliance-wars-of-2019|the Alliance Wars of 2019]]. SOL was still described as a current bloc in June 2019 — "the current SOL and Luna guilds" — and then vanishes from the record as Luna consolidated the map in July. No dissolution was ever recorded; June 2019 is simply its last attestation.

### The inferred roster
No member list of SOL was ever written down. The chronicle's six-guild roster — [[DiamondDeities]], Achte Shadow, Wrath Of Poseidon, Beyond the Scene, Spectral Cabbage, and from January 2019 Ecliptic Awakening — is inferred from map data: these guilds fought Luna's founders from Luna's founding onward across quiet (non-free-for-all) territories, Beyond the Scene alone accounting for nearly 4,000 quiet-territory exchanges, while showing near-zero fighting among themselves. The chronicle treats this roster as medium confidence. DiamondDeities' membership is consistent with the Treaty of Rodoroc — its peace with [[Kingdom Foxes]], effective 2 Mar 2019 — and with a late-2018 arrangement to share Molten Heights with Fox recorded on the community timeline.

## Membership
{{alliance:SOL}}

## Legacy
SOL bridged the Federation's fall and the alliance wars that consumed 2019: it inherited the map's chaos, provoked Luna into existence, and dissolved into obscurity without a recorded ending. Several of its inferred members resurfaced in the autumn blocs — DiamondDeities and Achte Shadow both appear in [[Terra]].

## Sources
- Community Timeline document ("Luna is formed as an alliance to counter SOL", 14 Feb 2019)
- Community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ), via forums thread 265297 — "SOL was created at this time"; the Molten Heights arrangement
- Wynncraft forums thread 251543 (Pikacal, 26 Jun 2019) — "the current SOL and Luna guilds"
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis — the inferred roster

articles.title: Terra
articles.summary: Terra was a short-lived Wynncraft war alliance of autumn 2019 — the bloc that broke Luna's total map control. Formed on 30 Aug 2019, it took the map on 8 Sep after The Simple Ones defected to it, and fell on 2 Nov 2019, its fragments launching one final raid on the newborn Artemis on 10 Nov.
articles.body:
**Terra** was a short-lived Wynncraft war alliance of autumn 2019 — the bloc that broke [[Luna]]'s total map control. Formed on 30 Aug 2019 and fallen by 2 Nov, it held the map for under two months, and its core went on to found the [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]].

## History

### Formation
Terra formed on 30 Aug 2019 in opposition to Luna, amid the Emorians–Avicia revolt that had broken out the day before; several of its guilds were already fighting Luna from 25 Aug.

### The Luna–Terra war
The war for the map ran 7–19 Sep 2019: over 2,000 attacks across 322 territories in ten days — a genuine full-map war, with only 37% of the fighting on the usual free-for-all hotspots. [[The Simple Ones]] defected from Luna to Terra on 8 Sep, and Terra took map control the same day; [[Kingdom Foxes]] left Luna on the 18th and Luna collapsed.

{{map:2019-09-08|The map as Terra took control}}

### Dispersal and fall
A week after victory, on 15 Sep 2019, Terra's core — Kingdom Foxes, [[DiamondDeities]], [[Titans Valor]], The Simple Ones, [[Fantasy]], Phantom Hearts and Empire of Sindria — founded the Council of Canyon Kingdoms. [[Paladins United]] departed at [[Artemis]]'s founding on 30 Oct. Terra itself fell on 2 Nov 2019, seven weeks after taking the map; on 10 Nov its fragments launched one final raid on the newborn Artemis.

## Membership
Terra's roster is largely map-inferred: the Timeline document's founding roster is literally a placeholder, and only The Simple Ones' membership is documented (it joined hours after leaving Luna). The other recorded members are the guilds that mounted 100 or more attacks on Luna during the decisive September war window.

{{alliance:Terra}}

## Legacy
Terra ended the last period of single-alliance map control in 2019 and seeded what came next: its core formed the Council of Canyon Kingdoms, and Paladins United left it to co-found Artemis, the alliance that would anchor the following era.

## Sources
- Community Timeline document — the 30 Aug formation and The Simple Ones' defection
- Community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ), via forums thread 265297 — the 2 Nov fall and the 10 Nov raid on Artemis
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis — war volumes and the inferred roster

articles.title: The Federation
articles.summary: The Federation was the dominant Wynncraft war alliance of 2018, founded around 16 Feb 2018 and led by Drew1011. It held the entire territory map for 8 months and 25 days, grew to 37–40 member guilds, and died by internal collapse in a single day on 10 Nov 2018.
articles.body:
The **Federation** (tag **Fed**) was the dominant war alliance of 2018 on Wynncraft — the largest alliance the game had yet seen, holding the entire territory map for eight months and twenty-five days before collapsing in a single day on 10 Nov 2018. Founded and unofficially led by [[Drew1011]], it grew to 37–40 member guilds and gave its name to the [[federation-era|Federation era]].

## History

### Formation
The Federation was born from the fracture of the [[Coalition]]. Around 16 Feb 2018, five guilds left the Coalition over map disputes and formed [[Alliance Alliance]]; the Coalition remnant merged with the remains of War Syndicate — the power the Coalition had wiped the previous Christmas — into a new alliance, founded and led by Drew1011. Even its genealogy was disputed among participants: a 2020 retrospective describes the Coa–WS merger as "a creation of fed", while Slayne wrote in 2018, "I created Fed because I (along with some others) created Double AA."

### The wipe of HackForums
On 19 Feb 2018, three days after forming, the Federation attacked [[HackForums]]' 111 territories and [[the-wipe-of-hackforums|wiped them to zero]] in under 12 hours — the end of Hax as a territorial power, a year after its 2017 peak of roughly 350 territories.

### Map dominance
The Federation took full map control on 20 Mar 2018, ending the [[coalition-civil-war|Coalition Civil War]] and absorbing the Alliance Alliance guilds. By its founder's account it held the entire map for 8 months and 25 days, with a roughly three-day interruption in March. An archived guild-leaderboard capture of 16 Apr 2018 shows all fifteen territory holders on the map were Federation guilds, together holding 384 territories.

{{map:2018-04-16|The Federation's map at its height}}

Membership churned heavily — [[Titans Valor]] alone served three separate stints. Within the bloc, [[Fantasy]], Sins of Seedia and IceBlue Team formed the [[Aesir Pact]] on 25 Mar 2018, a pact of sister guilds dedicated to Gavel. Fantasy itself left the Federation in late May 2018 — a departure recorded nowhere in writing, but map-data analysis shows off-FFA fighting jumping to sustained war levels in the week of 28 May — and fought the bloc across more than 220 territories all summer before rejoining on 29 Oct 2018.

### Collapse
At around 3 AM EST on 10 Nov 2018, one guild left the Federation — and the alliance cascaded apart within a day. The sequence of [[the-federation-dies|the Federation's death]] was recorded by members days later: The Hive had left a month earlier, then Odysseia; [[Imperial]]'s exit for independence "snowballed into a major attack together with the enemy alliance"; Arisen followed, and after 14 hours of constant warring the Aesir Pact guilds quit, ending it. "What killed Federation was... internal affairs," wrote Drew1011 in his tribute, posted three days later with the full member roster.

## Membership
The founder's tribute names 37 member guilds (one of them, "Death Reapers", resolves to no known guild in the prefix record); with renames and re-joins the chronicle records the alliance at 37–40 guilds. Rename chains within the roster — LE Flowers → [[DiamondDeities]], DogsAmongUs → White Lotus, As Darkness Falls → Constellations — are verified by abutting activity windows in the exchange data.

{{alliance:Federation}}

## Legacy
The Federation's fall ended 2018's era of single-bloc dominance and opened a winter interregnum in which, per the community timeline, "all guilds keep to themselves with valk owning most of Gavel" — the quiet territorial peak of the [[Valkyrie]] network. [[SOL]] was created in the post-collapse chaos, and [[Luna]] was formed to counter it in February 2019, beginning [[the-alliance-wars-of-2019|the Alliance Wars of 2019]]. No later alliance matched the Federation's documented duration of total map control.

## Sources
- "Federation Tribute" by Drew1011, Wynncraft forums thread 237070 (13 Nov 2018) — roster, founding-date math, death date
- "R.i.p Fed", Wynncraft forums thread 236962 (Nov 2018) — collapse sequence
- Community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ), via forums thread 265297, incl. its Apr 2020 genealogy posts
- Wayback Machine guild-leaderboard API capture of 16 Apr 2018 (pre-2018 territory snapshots)
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (Fantasy's map-inferred departure; rename-chain verification)

articles.title: Valhalla
articles.summary: Valhalla was the dominant war alliance of mid-to-late 2021, formed on 11 May 2021 by thirteen guilds — including The Aquarium — out of the simultaneous collapse of Goose and Artemis. It took map control within days and held it until its members reorganized as Vanir on 28 November 2021.
articles.body:
**Valhalla** was the dominant war alliance of mid-to-late 2021, formed on 11 May 2021 by thirteen guilds — including [[The Aquarium]] — out of the simultaneous collapse of [[Goose]] and [[Artemis]]. It took map control within days and held it until its members reorganized as [[Vanir]] on 28 November 2021.

## History

### Founding
On 11 May 2021, in [[the-great-collapse|The Great Collapse]], Goose and Artemis dissolved on the same day. Thirteen guilds — drawn from Goose's broad membership together with Artemis alumni such as [[Titans Valor]] — formed Valhalla, with Guardian of Wynn joining immediately after the founding. A megalist post of 25 May 2021 corroborates the reorganization: “the two major alliances both disbanded and got new names… Valhalla and Kaos”. No public roster was ever posted — the megalist's alliance rosters lived in a Google Sheet never captured by any archive — and the chronicle's membership derives from the community Timeline document. This is the first alliance membership recorded for The Aquarium in the chronicle.

### Dominance
Valhalla took map control from Goose's remnants in mid-May 2021 and dominated for the rest of the year while fighting the [[valhalla-khaos-war|Valhalla-Khaos war]]. A forum thread of 25 September 2021 captures its standing: “the meta of being top 10 on the guild sr leaderboard is to join valhalla”.

### Betrayal and reorganization
Friction with two members, The Mage Legacy and TheNoLifes, is visible in map data from August 2021. Both turned openly on their allies — December 2021 saw 5,359 quiet-territory exchanges as the fighting erupted — and when ten Valhalla guilds reorganized as Vanir on 28 November 2021, both were excluded. Per testimony, TheNoLifes went on to help lead [[Khaos]]. No formal Valhalla dissolution was ever recorded; its end date is inferred from Vanir's founding.

## Membership
{{alliance:Valhalla}}

## Legacy
Valhalla headed the alliance line that ran Goose–Valhalla–Vanir and, after the winter war with Khaos, fed the [[the-realignment-era|2022 realignment]] into [[Cucumber Company]]. Its era also marks the closing of the public record: it was the first dominant alliance whose roster never appeared in public.

## Sources
- community Timeline document (founding roster, map control, reorganization)
- Wynncraft forums thread 278112 (“the megalist”), post of 25 May 2021, via Wayback Machine
- Wynncraft forums thread 295680 (25 Sep 2021)
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (August 2021 friction; December 2021 eruption)
- oral-history testimony (Cameron, TAq veteran): the betrayal's aftermath

Self-described as a community alliance across seven years, it persisted beneath every war bloc from the Federation to the eve of the 2022 realignment.

articles.body:
**Valkyrie** (tag **Valk**) was the longest-lived alliance in Wynncraft history, running continuously from its founding on 2 Jun 2015 to its last attestation on 19 Sep 2022. Founded by Kingdom of Foxes (later [[Kingdom Foxes]]) and [[Imperial]] "not for the purpose of war" and governed by an Electorate of guild masters, it persisted as a social and political layer beneath — and once, briefly, above — every war bloc from the [[early-guild-era|early guild era]] to the eve of [[the-realignment-era|the realignment era]].

## History

### Founding and early years (2015–2017)
Valkyrie was founded on 2 Jun 2015 by Kingdom of Foxes and Imperial, describing itself from the start as an alliance not established for the purpose of war, governed by an Electorate of member guild masters. A 2016 forum thread still lists it as the pairing of those two guilds; Imperial formally left in October 2016. Through the "rump era" of Oct 2016 – Mar 2017 the attested membership was Kingdom Foxes, Holders Of LE and HaHaUnited. [[Drew1011]]'s forum profile titles record him as Leader of the Valkyrie Alliance from Oct 2016 to Mar 2018.

### The Federation years (2018)
Valkyrie persisted through the year of [[the-federation|the Federation]]'s total map dominance, several of its members simultaneously inside the war bloc. The Hive joined around March 2018 (welcomed that April as having "joined a month prior"), and [[Emorians]] joined on 23 May 2018. The stints of Holders Of LE and HaHaUnited are approximated as ending at a leadership restructure on 10 Mar 2018, after which neither is re-attested.

### The interregnum (winter 2018–19)
After [[the-federation-dies|the Federation died]] in November 2018, the community timeline records that "all guilds keep to themselves with valk owning most of Gavel" — the closest the alliance ever came to territorial power in its own name. Exchange data corroborates it: Kingdom Foxes and Imperial were the interregnum's top territory gainers. Drew1011's Valkyrie officer titles run through Jan 2019.

### Luna and after (2019)
In 2019 the bloc warred publicly as [[Luna]], with Valkyrie remaining the social layer beneath the war alliance — the chronicle resolves the apparent Fox-versus-Imperial fighting of that spring this way, as a war fought under Luna's banner. Emorians' Valkyrie stint ends with its August 2019 Luna exit. Imperial is re-attested as a member from 14 Sep 2019 via a member-written Wattpad history, and [[Paladins United]] is first attested a member the same day.

### Final years (2020–2022)
Valkyrie still described itself as a community alliance "built on friendship" in 2020, and a Paladins United member wrote simply "In Valk" in March 2020. Through the May 2021 realignment that produced [[Valhalla]] and [[Khaos]], a megalist contributor noted that "Valkyrie stayed the same" while the two major alliances renamed. Paladins United's thread OP listed "Valkyrie and [[Hestia]], both community alliances" from Nov 2021 until 19 Sep 2022 — the last attestation of Valkyrie anywhere. No dissolution was ever recorded. The satirical "Greater Valkyrie Alliance" thread of October 2022 involved unrelated guilds trading on the name.

## Membership
Valkyrie's full roster was never published in any era; the chronicle records only the attested stints — never more than three guilds at once.

{{alliance:Valkyrie}}

## Legacy
Valkyrie outlived every war alliance of its time — [[Coalition]], [[the-federation|Federation]], [[Luna]], [[Terra]], [[Artemis]], [[Valhalla]] — spanning seven years and every era of guild warfare from 2015 to 2022. The chronicle classifies it as a war alliance for its interregnum territorial phase, but in each of its own self-descriptions across seven years it was a community alliance first.

## Sources
- Wynncraft forums threads 89529, 135149, 147790, 159734, 263975, 266020 and 246617 (with Wayback captures) — founding, the Electorate, membership attestations
- Drew1011's forum profile title-chain — Valkyrie Leader/officer titles, Oct 2016 – Jan 2019
- "Inside Myself", member-written Wattpad history (wattpad.com/784189853), 14 Sep 2019
- [[the-forum-megalist|The forum megalist]] (thread 278112), Dream's post of 25 May 2021 ("Valkyrie stayed the same")
- Paladins United thread OP, Nov 2021 – 19 Sep 2022 (via Wayback captures)
- Community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ), via thread 265297 — the interregnum entry
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis — interregnum territory gains

articles.title: Vanir
articles.summary: Vanir was the short-lived successor to Valhalla, formed on 28 November 2021 by ten of its guilds including The Aquarium. It inherited the war with Khaos and collapsed just twenty days later, on 18 December 2021, when Emorians, Nefarious Ravens, IceBlue Team and Avicia left.
articles.body:
**Vanir** was the short-lived successor to [[Valhalla]]: formed on 28 November 2021 by ten of its guilds, it collapsed just twenty days later, on 18 December 2021.

## History
On 28 November 2021 ten Valhalla guilds — including [[The Aquarium]] — reorganized as Vanir. Guardian of Wynn and Nefarious Ravens were invited on 1 December. The reorganization doubled as a purge: The Mage Legacy and TheNoLifes, whose friction with the bloc had been visible in map data since August, were excluded, and their war on their former allies erupted that December — 5,359 quiet-territory exchanges in the month. Vanir inherited Valhalla's side of the ongoing [[valhalla-khaos-war|Valhalla-Khaos war]].

The alliance did not survive the month. On 18 December 2021 [[Emorians]], Nefarious Ravens, IceBlue Team and [[Avicia]] left, and Vanir collapsed. [[Niflheim]], the community alliance overlapping much of its world, officially dissolved the same day. The causes of the collapse were never publicly recorded.

## Membership
{{alliance:Vanir}}

## Legacy
Vanir was the last alliance of the Valhalla line, and its twenty-day life marks the moment the era's mega-blocs stopped holding together. The winter that followed — [[Khaos]]'s last war against the ex-Vanir guilds — ended in the [[the-realignment-era|2022 realignment]] that produced [[Cucumber Company]], where most Vanir guilds reappeared alongside their former Khaos enemies.

## Sources
- community Timeline document (founding, invitations, collapse)
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (December 2021 eruption)

articles.title: Aequitas-Avicia war
articles.summary: The largest war in the entire territory record: Aequitas against Avicia, 3 November to 21 December 2025, with 15,710 quiet-territory exchanges (21,526 total) and a weekly peak of 4,736. It was over by Christmas.
