infobox.value: 15,710 quiet-territory exchanges (21,526 total); weekly peak 4,736 — the largest war in the territory record

articles.body:
The Aequitas-Avicia war of November–December 2025 is the largest war in the entire territory record: 15,710 quiet-territory exchanges — 21,526 including all exchanges — between [[Aequitas]] and [[Avicia]] in seven weeks, with a weekly peak of 4,736.

{{map:2025-11-03|The map when the war began}}

{{war-chart:Aequitas|Avicia|2025-10-19|2026-01-03}}

## Background

Like every war of [[private-diplomacy-era|the private-diplomacy era]], it has no written record: no declaration, no named cause, no published sides beyond the two principals. By late 2025 even the forum's guild-politics venue was gone — the official Discord's #guild-politics channel had been renamed #guild-community that October, and in the words of one guild founder, 'real diplomacy happens in private alliance chats'. Map-data analysis is the sole source.

## Course of the war

The war ran from 3 November to 21 December 2025. Its seven weeks produced more quiet-territory exchanges than any other conflict in the dataset, surpassing the multi-year bloc wars of 2021–22 in raw volume. Which side prevailed is not recorded; the war was over by Christmas.

## Aftermath

No settlement is recorded. Within a year Aequitas was at war again — [[aequitas-sequoia-war|against Sequoia]], the conflict still running as of September 2026.

## Sources

- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (dates, exchange totals, weekly peak; no written record of this war exists)
- Wynncraft forums thread 322643 (Oct 2025) — the #guild-politics rename; IceResistance on private diplomacy
- Chronicle event record: Aequitas-Avicia war

articles.title: Aequitas-Sequoia war
articles.summary: The current war: after a one-week clash in August 2025 and spring 2026 skirmishes, full war between Aequitas and Sequoia erupted in the week of 24 August 2026 — 7,488 quiet-territory exchanges in its first week, with Aequitas driven to zero territories. Ongoing as of September 2026.

infobox.label: Status
infobox.value: Ongoing (as of Sep 2026); Aequitas at zero territories

articles.body:
The Aequitas-Sequoia war is the current war of the Wynncraft territory map: full war between [[Aequitas]] and [[Sequoia]] erupted in the week of 24 August 2026 and is ongoing as of early September 2026.

{{map:2026-08-24|The map when full war erupted}}

{{war-chart:Aequitas|Sequoia|2026-08-09|2026-09-16}}

## Background

The two guilds had clashed before: a one-week fight in August 2025, then renewed skirmishes through spring 2026. Sequoia entered the war as the dominant guild of the era, winner of seven consecutive [[guild-seasons|guild seasons]] from mid-2024 and survivor of [[avicia-sequoia-war|its 2023 war with Avicia]]; Aequitas came off [[aequitas-avicia-war|the largest war in the territory record]] the previous winter, and before that [[the-long-raid|the Long Raid siege]] of 2024.

As with every conflict of [[private-diplomacy-era|the private-diplomacy era]], no cause or declaration was published anywhere; the record is map data and the official API.

## Course of the war

The opening week was among the most violent ever recorded: 7,488 quiet-territory exchanges, with Aequitas driven to zero territories — confirmed at zero by the official API on 2 September 2026.

The war continues, and this account can only cover it through early September 2026. Its later course, and any settlement, are not yet part of the record.

## Aftermath

Not yet written. Notably, this war is the first major conflict fought in the era of [[first-machine-recorded-alliances|machine-recorded alliances]]: since June 2026 Sequoia's own mod has captured in-game alliance events, so this war's diplomacy may one day be reconstructable in a way no earlier war's is.

## Sources

- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (Aug 2025 clash; spring 2026 skirmishes; week of 24 Aug 2026 eruption, 7,488 exchanges)
- Official Wynncraft API, v3/guild (Aequitas at zero territories, verified 2 Sep 2026)
- Chronicle event record: Aequitas-Sequoia war

articles.title: Avicia-Sequoia war
articles.summary: Avicia's war with the young Sequoia: skirmishes through spring 2023, a main eruption from 30 October to 20 November 2023 peaking at 1,454 quiet-territory exchanges per week, and a second round in January 2024.
articles.body:
The Avicia-Sequoia war was fought between [[Avicia]], a veteran of every major bloc since 2019, and [[Sequoia]], a guild barely a year old — founded 14 October 2022 — whose rise it did nothing to stop.

{{map:2023-10-30|The map when the main eruption began}}

{{war-chart:Avicia|Sequoia|2023-10-15|2024-02-13}}

## Background

The war belongs to [[private-diplomacy-era|the private-diplomacy era]]: no written record of it exists — no declaration, no forum thread, no named cause. Everything known comes from territory_exchanges map-data analysis. Skirmishing between the two guilds is visible through spring 2023, while Avicia was still in [[smtn elf]] and then in the [[Avocado Aquarium]] pact.

## Course of the war

The main eruption ran from 30 October to 20 November 2023, peaking at 1,454 quiet-territory exchanges per week. A second round followed in January 2024. Which side held the advantage is not recorded; the exchange data measures intensity, not victory.

## Aftermath

Sequoia's rise continued regardless of the war: from mid-2024 it won seven consecutive [[guild-seasons|guild seasons]]. Sequoia and [[Aequitas]] would later fight the wars that closed the decade's record, including [[aequitas-sequoia-war|the ongoing war of 2026]]; Avicia went on to fight [[aequitas-avicia-war|the largest war in the territory record]] in late 2025.

## Sources

- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (war windows and weekly peak; no written record of this war exists)
- Guild API record: Sequoia founded 14 Oct 2022
- Chronicle event record: Avicia-Sequoia war

articles.title: Coalition Civil War
articles.summary: The February-March 2018 war between the Coalition and Alliance Alliance, the breakaway bloc formed by five of its member guilds. It ended on 20 March 2018 when the newly formed Federation took control of the entire map.

infobox.label: Outcome
infobox.value: The [[the-federation|Federation]] took control of the map; both belligerent alliances ceased to exist

articles.body:
The Coalition Civil War was fought from 17 February to 20 March 2018 between the [[Coalition]] and [[Alliance Alliance]], the bloc formed by five guilds that quit it. The war ended when the newly formed [[the-federation|Federation]] took control of the map, opening the [[federation-era|Federation era]].

{{map:2018-02-17|The map when the Coalition split}}

## Background

The Coalition was founded in October 2017 by [[Kingdom Foxes]], KingdomPhoenixes, Gilded Sparrows and House of Sentinels. It took control of the Wynn Province on 23 November 2017, wiped War Syndicate on Christmas Day, and from then on held full dominance of the map.

## Course of the war

On 16–17 February 2018, five member guilds — [[HackForums]], [[Paladins United]], House of Sentinels, [[Emorians]] and Kangronomicon — left the Coalition over map disputes and formed Alliance Alliance together with [[Fantasy]] and Necronomicon, declaring war on their former alliance. (The community timeline image dates the split to 16 February; the Timeline document says 17 February.)

The split ended the Coalition as an entity almost at once: its remnant merged with the remains of War Syndicate into a new alliance, the Federation, founded and led by [[Drew1011]]. Three days later the Federation destroyed HackForums' territorial holdings in a single half-day operation — see [[the-wipe-of-hackforums|The wipe of HackForums]].

The war ended on 20 March 2018, when the Federation took control of the entire map.

No war chart is available for this conflict at bloc level; the fighting involved two multi-guild alliances rather than a single pair of guilds, and the territory-exchange log only begins in January 2018.

## Aftermath

With the war over, Alliance Alliance dissolved and several of its guilds — Fantasy, Paladins United and Emorians among them — joined the Federation, which went on to hold the entire map for 8 months and 25 days, until [[the-federation-dies|its death in November 2018]]. The Federation's genealogy remained disputed among veterans: Lego_DW later wrote that 'Coa and WS merged... this was a creation of fed', while Slayne claimed in 2018 to have created it via Alliance Alliance.

## Sources

- Community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ, via Wynncraft forums thread 265297)
- Community Timeline document (chronicle import, 2018–2021)
- Wynncraft forums thread 265297, Lego_DW's Federation genealogy post (Apr 2020)
- Chronicle alliance records: Coalition, Alliance Alliance, Federation

articles.title: CoCK collapses
articles.summary: The Council of Canyon Kingdoms collapsed on 23 Nov 2019 when The Ascendancy bloc departed, two days after Titans Valor and DiamondDeities left — ending the alliance formed from Terra's victorious core just ten weeks earlier.
articles.body:
The [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]] — CCK, or CoCK — was formed on 15 Sep 2019 by the victorious core of [[Terra]]: [[Kingdom Foxes]], [[DiamondDeities]], [[Titans Valor]], [[The Simple Ones]], [[Fantasy]], Phantom Hearts and Empire of Sindria. It outlived its parent by only three weeks.

## The collapse

The end came in stages. Kingdom Foxes left at the start of November, as [[terra-falls|Terra fell]]; Phantom Hearts had already abandoned the council in early October. On 21 Nov 2019 Titans Valor and DiamondDeities departed, and on 23 Nov the bloc known as The Ascendancy left, collapsing the alliance.

The Ascendancy itself is one of the record's blind spots: the community timeline dates its creation to 27 Apr 2019, and the Timeline document attests its departure from CoCK — but no roster of it was ever recorded anywhere.

## Aftermath

The council's fragments regrouped within days: on 1 Dec 2019 DiamondDeities, Titans Valor and The Simple Ones formed [[Horologium]], while [[Imperial]], Paladins United and Caeruleum Order had already founded [[Artemis]] on 30 Oct. Horologium lasted five weeks before [[diamonddeities-disbanded|DiamondDeities' disbandment]] took it down; Artemis went on to dominate 2020.

## Sources

- community Timeline document (the 23 Nov collapse and the Ascendancy departure)
- community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ, via forums thread 265297 — The Ascendancy's 27 Apr 2019 creation)

articles.title: DiamondDeities disbanded
articles.summary: Nitrogen2Oxygen dissolved DiamondDeities on 8 Jan 2020, taking the Horologium alliance down with it; most remaining members regrouped as Lux Nova the next day.
articles.body:
On 8 Jan 2020 [[nitrogen2oxygen|Nitrogen2Oxygen]] dissolved [[DiamondDeities]], one of the central guilds of the post-Federation era — and took [[Horologium]] down with it, the three-guild alliance de-facto dissolving the same day. Most remaining members regrouped as Lux Nova the next day.

## The guild's arc

DiamondDeities packed its history into under two years. It began as LE Flowers, a founding-era member of [[The Federation]], and took the DiamondDeities name in the spring of 2018 — a rename verified in the chronicle by abutting activity windows. On 18 Jul 2018 it was accepted into the [[Aesir Pact]], and its guilds were among the Federation's last defenders when [[the-federation-dies|the alliance fell]] that November.

After the collapse it fought with [[sol|SOL]], signed the [[Treaty of Rodoroc]] with [[Kingdom Foxes]] (effective 2 Mar 2019), joined [[Terra]] for the [[Luna-Terra war]], and passed through the [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]] into Horologium — five blocs in fourteen months.

## Aftermath

Horologium's other members, [[Titans Valor]] and [[The Simple Ones]], were left allianceless as the map consolidated under [[Artemis]]. Lux Nova carried DiamondDeities' lineage onward, appearing later in [[Hestia]], [[Valhalla]] and [[Vanir]].

## Sources

- community Timeline document (the disbandment, Horologium's de-facto dissolution, the Lux Nova regroup)
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (the LE Flowers rename chain)
- "The Aesir Pact", forums thread 227373 (the 18 Jul 2018 acceptance)

articles.title: Emorians and Avicia revolt
articles.summary: On 29 Aug 2019, after a leadership dispute, Emorians and Avicia left Luna and declared war on Imperial, spiralling into a large war over Gavel. Terra formed in the chaos, and within three weeks Luna had lost the map and collapsed.
articles.body:
## Background

[[Luna]] had [[luna-gains-full-map-control|held the entire map]] since 17 Jul 2019, when [[Avicia]] joined as the last guild standing outside it. The alliance's unity did not survive the calm that followed.

## The revolt

On 29 Aug 2019, after a leadership dispute, [[Emorians]] and Avicia left Luna and declared war on [[Imperial]], Luna's core guild. The fighting spiralled into a large war over Gavel. ThisIsMurica was kicked from Luna the next day for sending fighters to the rebels' side, and on 30 Aug [[Terra]] formed in the chaos, gathering Luna's enemies into a bloc.

{{war-chart:Emorians|Imperial|2019-08-14|2019-10-03}}

{{map:2019-08-29|The map when the revolt began}}

## Aftermath

The revolt did not stay a revolt. Within a week it had merged into the decisive [[Luna-Terra war]]: The Simple Ones defected on 8 Sep and Terra took the map the same day; Kingdom Foxes left on the 18th and Luna collapsed. Emorians' and Avicia's walkout thus began the three-week sequence that ended Luna's rule entirely.

## Sources

- community Timeline document (the 29 Aug dispute and departures, the ThisIsMurica kick, Terra's formation)
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (the Gavel war's course)

articles.title: Fall of Profession Heaven's neutrality
articles.summary: On 25 May 2026 KongoBoys began a sustained campaign against Profession Heaven — up to 1,700 quiet-territory exchanges a week — ending the neutral profession-XP guild's five years of protected status. Ongoing as of September 2026.
articles.body:
## Background

[[Profession Heaven]] had been a protected neutral guild since 25 Jan 2021, when [[Goose]] and [[Artemis]] jointly guaranteed its status and granted it Silent Expanse territory as a public profession-XP guild ([[Profession Heaven neutrality]]). The protection carried through both alliances' successors, and Profession Heaven itself was a member of [[Cucumber Company]] and [[smtn-elf|smtn elf]] — as was KongoBoys, its future attacker.

## Course of the war

On 25 May 2026 KongoBoys began a sustained campaign against Profession Heaven, running as high as 1,700 quiet-territory exchanges a week — ending more than five years of neutrality. Like every conflict of the [[private-diplomacy-era|private-diplomacy era]], the war has no written record: no declaration, no stated cause, no named coalition. It is attested by map data alone, and the campaign is ongoing as of September 2026.

{{war-chart:KongoBoys|Profession Heaven|2026-05-10|2026-09-02}}

{{map:2026-05-25|The map when the campaign began}}

## Aftermath

The attack closed the era's longest-standing diplomatic arrangement — the only guild ever protected by both sides of a map-wide war. Whatever caused the break between the two former smtn elf allies is unrecorded.

## Sources

- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (weekly capture volumes; the 25 May 2026 ignition)
- community Timeline document (the 2021 neutrality grant)

articles.title: Fantasy turns on The Federation
articles.summary: Fantasy left the dominant Federation in late May 2018 and fought the map-holding bloc alone all summer, exchanging over 220 territories before rejoining on 29 Oct 2018 — twelve days before the Federation's death.
articles.body:
## Background

By the spring of 2018 [[The Federation]] held the entire map, having taken it at the end of the [[Coalition Civil War]] on 20 Mar 2018. [[Fantasy]] entered the bloc that day with the other [[alliance-alliance|Alliance Alliance]] guilds, and five days later co-founded the [[Aesir Pact]], the Federation's sister-guild pact "especially dedicated to Gavel."

## Course of the war

Fantasy's departure was never announced in writing; map-data analysis places it in the week of 28 May 2018, when Fantasy's fighting against Federation guilds away from the FFA hotspots jumps from peace level (44 exchanges in total through April) to sustained war levels of 20–90 exchanges per week on quiet territories. The lone guild then fought the map-holding bloc across the whole summer — over 220 territories were exchanged with the Federation before the war ended.

The record preserves an unresolved oddity: Fantasy was an Aesir Pact founder, and no source records the pact expelling it. The sister-guild pact evidently survived Fantasy's war on the very alliance that contained it.

## Aftermath

Fantasy rejoined the Federation on 29 Oct 2018 — the only date of this war the written record preserves — twelve days before the alliance [[the-federation-dies|died by internal collapse]] on 10 Nov 2018.

{{map:2018-05-28|The map when Fantasy left the Federation}}

## Sources

- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (off-FFA fighting at war level from the week of 28 May 2018; 220+ territories exchanged)
- community Timeline document (the 29 Oct 2018 rejoin — the war's only written date)
- "The Aesir Pact", Wynncraft forums thread 227373 (5 Jun 2018)

articles.title: Goose-Artemis war
articles.summary: The war for the map that ended the Artemis era, December 2020 to May 2021. An unnamed anti-Artemis coalition erupted against the map-holder alliance, carried the name Goose by January 2021, and fought until both alliances collapsed on the same day.

infobox.label: Outcome
infobox.value: Mutual collapse of both alliances on 11 May 2021 ([[the-great-collapse|The Great Collapse]])

articles.body:
The Goose-Artemis war was the conflict that ended the [[artemis-goose-era|Artemis era]]: the map-holding [[Artemis]] alliance against the coalition that became [[Goose]], fought from December 2020 until both alliances collapsed on 11 May 2021.

{{map:2020-12-01|The map when the war erupted}}

## Background

Artemis had been formed on 30 October 2019 by [[Imperial]], [[Paladins United]] and Caeruleum Order, and transformed across 2020: by March 2020 [[Kingdom Foxes]] was a member and [[ShadowFall]] held a leadership seat, and by December 2020 it was described as 'the war alliance made up of all the current massive land holding guilds', including [[Titans Valor]]. By then its own founders Paladins United and Imperial had drifted out — both appear on the opposing side.

## Course of the war

After months of skirmishing, the war erupted in December 2020 — 913 quiet-territory exchanges that month by map-data analysis. A forum post of 18 December 2020 describes the ongoing conflict and lists the opposing coalition, then still unnamed; the earliest recorded use of the name Goose is 19 January 2021. A February 2021 thread records 'Artemis guilds warring the Rays-held desert'.

Goose grew through the spring. On 1 February 2021 a megalist post recorded that ShadowFall, IceBlue Team and TheNoLifes were 'all goose now' — a side-switch from the Artemis world — and by March–April 2021 the coalition had absorbed the future [[Khaos]] core: [[Aequitas]], Wheres The Finish, ChinaNumberOne, Fuzzy Spiders and Eden. Goose took control of the map.

Amid the fighting, on 25 January 2021, both alliances jointly granted [[Profession Heaven]] neutral status as a public profession-XP guild — a protection that held for five years.

No war chart is shown: this was a bloc-level war between two multi-guild alliances, not a guild pair. An earlier map-only reconstruction dated the war from March 2020; the attested record places its eruption in December 2020.

## Aftermath

The war ended on 11 May 2021 when Goose and Artemis both collapsed on the same day — [[the-great-collapse|The Great Collapse]] — reforming as [[Valhalla]] and [[Khaos]], whose [[valhalla-khaos-war|war]] began immediately.

## Sources

- Wynncraft forums thread 279337 (Sheepn, 18 Dec 2020) — the conflict and the unnamed coalition's roster
- Wynncraft forums thread 278112 ('the megalist'), posts of 19 Jan 2021, 1 Feb 2021 and 4 Mar 2021 (via Wayback)
- Wynncraft forums thread 286375 (99loulou999, 20 Feb 2021)
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (December 2020 ignition; 913 quiet exchanges)
- Chronicle records: Artemis, Goose, Profession Heaven neutrality

articles.title: Idiot Co-Aquarium war
articles.summary: The biggest war since 2021: Idiot Co against The Aquarium, igniting 29 April 2024 and raging through mid-July with a weekly peak of 5,045 quiet-territory exchanges, then a second round from November 2024 into January 2025.
articles.body:
The Idiot Co-Aquarium war was the biggest war since 2021, fought between [[Idiot Co]] and [[The Aquarium]] across two rounds from April 2024 into January 2025.

{{map:2024-04-29|The map when the war ignited}}

{{war-chart:Idiot Co|The Aquarium|2024-04-14|2025-02-13}}

## Background

Both guilds had shared an alliance not long before: Idiot Co joined [[smtn elf]] in March 2023, months before The Aquarium walked out in [[the-avocado-split|the Avocado split]]. By 2024, guild diplomacy had moved into private Discords — [[private-diplomacy-era|the private-diplomacy era]] — and no written record of this war's causes, sides beyond the two principals, or settlement exists. Map-data analysis is the sole source; the wider coalitions visible in the exchange data have no recorded names or rosters.

## Course of the war

The war ignited on 29 April 2024 and raged through mid-July, peaking at 5,045 quiet-territory exchanges in a single week — the highest weekly volume since the wars of 2021. A second round ran from November 2024 into January 2025.

The war spanned the Rekindled World map rework of 10 August 2024, which redrew the territory map between its two rounds.

## Aftermath

No settlement was recorded. The fighting faded in January 2025, and the record's attention moved to the wars around [[Aequitas]] and [[Sequoia]] that followed later that year. Within the war's window falls [[the-long-raid|The Long Raid]] of late July 2024 — a siege of Aequitas's Sky-province claim described as small-guild warfare, whose attackers were never named.

## Sources

- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (ignition 29 Apr 2024, weekly peak 5,045, second round Nov 2024 – Jan 2025; the wider coalitions have no written record)
- Chronicle event record: Idiot Co-Aquarium war; Rekindled World rework date

articles.title: Khaos's last war
articles.summary: Khaos's war against the ex-Valhalla/Vanir guilds peaked in January 2022 at 500–800 quiet-territory exchanges per week and faded to nothing by mid-July. Khaos was defunct by 26 June 2022, its guilds absorbed into Cucumber Company.

infobox.label: Outcome
infobox.value: Khaos defunct by 26 Jun 2022; merger into [[Cucumber Company]]

articles.body:
## Background

The [[Valhalla-Khaos war]] had run since 11 May 2021, the day both blocs formed out of [[The Great Collapse]]. [[Vanir]] inherited Valhalla's side in November 2021 and then [[vanir-collapses|collapsed itself]] on 18 Dec, leaving [[Khaos]] facing an opposing coalition with no recorded name — remembered in testimony as "the Pineapple Pact", a name of which no written record survives.

## Course of the war

The war's final phase peaked in January 2022 at 500–800 quiet-territory exchanges per week. The principal guilds facing Khaos included [[The Aquarium]], [[Avicia]] and [[Titans Valor]]; on Khaos's side fought [[Aequitas]], Nerfuria and Eden. Through the spring the fighting faded steadily, reaching nothing by mid-July.

{{map:2022-01-15|The map at the war's January peak}}

## Aftermath

The war ended not in victory but in merger. Khaos was defunct by 26 Jun 2022, when the forum megalist's final alliance roster — the last ever posted publicly — showed its guilds absorbed into [[Cucumber Company]] alongside their former enemies. Map analysis corroborates the timing: ex-Khaos versus ex-Valhalla exchanges flip from war-shaped to trade-shaped in May–June 2022. No formal dissolution of Khaos was ever announced.

## Sources

- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (weekly capture volumes, January peak, the May–June flip)
- Cameron oral history (testimony — the "Pineapple Pact" name)
- the forum megalist, thread 278112 p8 (26 Jun 2022 — the defunct-by bound)

articles.title: Luna's war on Kingdom Foxes
articles.summary: Luna fought Kingdom Foxes across more than 300 territories from 15 Feb 2019 — its second day of existence — until Fox joined the alliance on 8 Jul 2019, directly after the Treaty of Ternaves. No contemporary document names the war; it is attested entirely by exchange data.
articles.body:
## Background

[[Luna]] was formed on 14 Feb 2019 to counter [[sol|SOL]], the war alliance born from the Federation's ashes. Some retellings list [[Kingdom Foxes]] among Luna's founders; exchange data contradicts them — Luna was at war with Fox from its second day of existence.

## Course of the war

From 15 Feb 2019 Luna fought Kingdom Foxes across more than 300 territories. [[Imperial]] alone attacked Fox 660 times between 16 Feb and 8 Jul. No contemporary document so much as names this war — it is attested entirely by territory-exchange data, which shows it running continuously for nearly five months while Fox stood outside every bloc.

{{map:2019-02-15|The map when the war began}}

## Aftermath

The war ended at the negotiating table rather than on the map. On 6 Jul 2019 Fox signed the [[Treaty of Ternaves]] with the Luna members [[The Simple Ones]] and ThisIsMurica, and directly afterwards, on 8 Jul 2019, Kingdom Foxes joined Luna itself. Within ten days the enlarged alliance had wiped every remaining guild but [[Avicia]] and [[luna-gains-full-map-control|gained full control of the map]].

Fox's membership proved short and consequential: it left on 18 Sep 2019 during the [[Luna-Terra war]], the departure that finished Luna's collapse.

## Sources

- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (300+ territories; Imperial's 660 attacks; the war is unnamed in every written source)
- community Timeline document (Luna's founding, the 8 Jul 2019 join)

articles.title: Luna-Terra war
articles.summary: The war for the map, 7–19 Sep 2019: over 2,000 exchanges across 322 territories in ten days. The Simple Ones defected from Luna on 8 Sep and Terra took map control the same day; Kingdom Foxes left on the 18th and Luna collapsed.

infobox.label: Outcome
infobox.value: Terra took the map; Luna collapsed

articles.body:
## Background

[[Luna]] had [[luna-gains-full-map-control|held the entire map]] since 17 Jul 2019, but the [[emorians-and-avicia-revolt|revolt of Emorians and Avicia]] on 29 Aug cracked it open, and on 30 Aug [[Terra]] formed in opposition — a bloc of roughly a dozen guilds including TheNoLifes, [[Titans Valor]], [[DiamondDeities]], [[Fantasy]] and Paladins United. Terra's roster was never published; it is largely reconstructed from map data.

## Course of the war

The decisive fighting ran 7–19 Sep 2019: over 2,000 exchanges across 322 territories in ten days, and map analysis shows only about a third of it on FFA hotspots — a genuine map-wide war, not churn. The turning point came within a day: on 8 Sep [[The Simple Ones]] defected from Luna to Terra, and Terra took control of the map that same day.

{{map:2019-09-08|The map as Terra took control}}

Luna fought on for another ten days until [[Kingdom Foxes]] left on 18 Sep, and the alliance collapsed.

## Aftermath

Victory dissolved the victor almost as fast as the vanquished. On 15 Sep, mid-war, Terra's core founded the [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]]; Terra itself [[terra-falls|fell]] on 2 Nov 2019, seven weeks after taking the map.

## Sources

- community Timeline document (the defection, the map change, Fox's departure)
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (2,174 attacks, 322 territories, 37% FFA share)

articles.title: smtn elf fades away
articles.summary: smtn elf's last recorded mention is Avicia's season post of 10 Jun 2023; days later The Aquarium and Avicia walked out, and by the 19 Aug 2023 season post the super-alliance had vanished from the record — no death announcement, just silence.

infobox.label: Date
infobox.value: June – August 2023 (end approximated to late June)

articles.body:
[[smtn-elf|smtn elf]] — the continuation of [[Cucumber Company]], and the dominant super-alliance of 2023 — died without an announcement.

## The fade

Its last recorded mention is Avicia's Season 12 post of 10 Jun 2023: "To our other allies in smtn elf... thank you for the hqs." Days later, on 14 Jun, [[The Aquarium]] and [[Avicia]] walked out — rejecting pressure, led by busted moments, to shrink their claims — and formed the two-guild [[Avocado Aquarium]] pact ([[The Avocado split]]).

By Avicia's Season 13 post of 19 Aug 2023 the alliance had vanished from the record entirely. That post instead thanks "The Aquarium - our unwavering ally"; smtn elf goes unmentioned, and no death announcement by any member was ever posted. The chronicle approximates the alliance's end to late June 2023.

## A quiet dissolution

The remaining guilds never fought each other: map analysis shows no infighting among the rump through 2024 — a fade, not a violent breakup. smtn elf proved to be the last of the public super-alliances; after it, diplomacy moved into private Discords ([[private-diplomacy-era|the private-diplomacy era]]), and no alliance of its scale was ever publicly named again.

## Sources

- Avicia season posts: forums threads 308780 (10 Jun 2023) and 310286 (19 Aug 2023) — the death bracket
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (no rump infighting)
- Cameron oral history (testimony — the claim-shrinking dispute)

articles.title: Terra falls
articles.summary: Terra, the alliance that broke Luna, fell on 2 Nov 2019 — seven weeks after its victory. On 10 Nov its fragments launched one last raid on the newborn Artemis.
articles.body:
[[Terra]] formed on 30 Aug 2019 in opposition to [[Luna]] and took the map from it on 8 Sep, after The Simple Ones' defection ([[Luna-Terra war]]). Its own end began almost immediately.

## The dispersal

Victory scattered the bloc in stages. On 15 Sep 2019 its core — [[Kingdom Foxes]], [[DiamondDeities]], [[Titans Valor]], [[The Simple Ones]], [[Fantasy]], Phantom Hearts and Empire of Sindria — left to found the [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]]. Paladins United departed on 30 Oct to co-found [[Artemis]]. What remained was a rump: chronicle stints place Lunatic, IceBlue Team, Achte Shadow and FinalFront in Terra to the start of November.

The community guild-timeline records the end simply: "November 2nd 2019 Terra 'falls'" — the quotation marks are in the original, and no fuller dissolution statement survives.

## The last raid

On 10 Nov 2019 Terra's fragments launched one final raid on the newborn Artemis, eleven days old. It was the bloc's last recorded act; its guilds then dispersed into the winter's realignments.

{{map:2019-11-02|The map when Terra fell}}

## Sources

- community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ, via forums thread 265297 — the 2 Nov fall and 10 Nov raid entries)
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (the rump roster's activity windows)

articles.title: The Avocado split
articles.summary: The Aquarium and Avicia quit the smtn elf super-alliance in June 2023, rejecting pressure to shrink their claims, and as the two-guild Avocado Aquarium pact waged a sniping and claim-taking campaign against their former allies into early 2024.

infobox.label: Belligerents
infobox.value: [[Avocado Aquarium]] ([[The Aquarium]], [[Avicia]]) vs their former [[smtn elf]] allies

infobox.label: Outcome
infobox.value: No recorded settlement; the campaign faded in early 2024, and smtn elf itself quietly dissolved

articles.body:
The Avocado split was the departure of [[The Aquarium]] and [[Avicia]] from the [[smtn elf]] super-alliance in June 2023 and the campaign the two guilds then waged against their former allies as the [[Avocado Aquarium]] pact, running into early 2024.

{{map:2023-06-14|The map when TAq and Avicia walked out}}

## Background

smtn elf was the direct continuation of [[Cucumber Company]], the mega-bloc of [[the-realignment-era|the 2022 realignment]] — called 'unquestionably the greatest super-alliance of 2023' in a February 2023 thread. Per testimony, pressure inside the alliance — led by busted moments, a member since March 2023 — for The Aquarium and Avicia to shrink their claims drove the two guilds out.

## Course of the war

The Aquarium and Avicia quit in mid-June 2023; map data dates the ignition of their war on their ex-allies to 14–15 June. As a two-guild pact they waged a sniping and claim-taking campaign, running mega-claims across TAq, AVO and their subguilds ShadowFall, the Avos, and the joint subguild Avoquarium [HQs], created 9 August 2023. By Avicia's August 2023 season post the two were each other's 'unwavering ally'.

The name 'Avocado Aquarium' comes from oral testimony and appears nowhere in writing; the pact's existence and campaign are attested by the season posts, the Avoquarium guild record and map data. No war chart is shown: the opposing side was the multi-guild smtn elf rump, not a single guild.

## Aftermath

smtn elf did not survive the walkout. Its last recorded mention is Avicia's Season 12 post of 10 June 2023; by the Season 13 post of 19 August 2023 it had vanished from the record — no death announcement, just silence. The remaining guilds never fought each other.

The Avocado campaign faded in early 2024; the chronicle approximates the pact's end to late February. The first friction between The Aquarium and Avicia themselves appears in map data only in June 2024, after the pact — by which time [[idiot-co-aquarium-war|the biggest war since 2021]] had begun. This corner of the record marks the start of [[private-diplomacy-era|the private-diplomacy era]]: no 2023–2026 bloc roster was ever published again.

## Sources

- Avicia's Season 12 post, 10 Jun 2023 (forums thread 308780) — last live mention of smtn elf, 'thank you for the hqs'
- Avicia's Season 13 post, 19 Aug 2023 (forums thread 310286) — 'The Aquarium - our unwavering ally'
- Guild API record: 'Avoquarium' [HQs] created 9 Aug 2023
- Cameron oral history (testimony: the claim-shrinking dispute, the pact's name)
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (campaign window Jun 2023 – Feb 2024)

articles.title: The betrayal of Valhalla
articles.summary: The Mage Legacy and TheNoLifes turned on their Valhalla allies — friction visible from August 2021, erupting into open war in December with 5,359 quiet-territory exchanges that month. Both were excluded when Vanir formed on 28 Nov 2021.

infobox.label: Belligerents
infobox.value: The Mage Legacy, TheNoLifes vs the [[Valhalla]]/[[Vanir]] guilds

articles.body:
## Background

The Mage Legacy and TheNoLifes were both [[Valhalla]] members from its founding on 11 May 2021, part of the thirteen-guild bloc that took the map after [[The Great Collapse]]. Friction between the two and their allies is visible in exchange data from August 2021, months before any open break.

## The betrayal

When Valhalla's guilds reorganized as [[Vanir]] on 28 Nov 2021, both were excluded. Open war followed in December: 5,359 quiet-territory exchanges that month between the two betrayers and their former allies — one of the most violent single months anywhere in the territory record.

The episode survives chiefly in oral history: the account of TAq veteran Cameron, fact-checked against map data, which confirms both the timing and the participants. Per that testimony, TheNoLifes went on to help lead [[Khaos]]; the chronicle records it as a Khaos member from about 1 Dec 2021, the join approximated to the betrayal itself.

{{map:2021-11-28|The map when Vanir formed without the betrayers}}

## Aftermath

By early 2022 the fighting had folded into [[khaos-s-last-war|Khaos's last war]], the winter-long struggle between Khaos and the ex-Valhalla guilds. TheNoLifes stayed hostile to its former allies into 2023, long after the blocs themselves had dissolved.

## Sources

- Cameron oral history (testimony; betrayal confirmed against map data)
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (August 2021 friction; the 5,359-exchange December)

articles.title: The Federation dies
articles.summary: The internal collapse of the Federation on 10 November 2018: one guild left at around 3 AM EST, and the alliance that had held the entire map for 8 months and 25 days cascaded apart within a day.

infobox.label: Alliance
infobox.value: [[the-federation|Federation]] (and the [[Aesir Pact]], which died with it)

infobox.label: Cause
infobox.value: Internal collapse — 'what killed Federation was... internal affairs' (Drew1011)

articles.body:
The death of the [[the-federation|Federation]] on 10 November 2018 ended the longest period of total map control in the recorded history of Wynncraft guild warfare. The alliance was not defeated from outside: one guild's departure at around 3 AM EST triggered a cascade that emptied it within a day.

{{map:2018-11-10|The map on the day of the collapse}}

## Background

The Federation formed around 16 February 2018 from the merger of the [[Coalition]] remnant and War Syndicate's remains, founded and led by [[Drew1011]]. It wiped [[HackForums]] on 19 February, won the [[coalition-civil-war|Coalition Civil War]] on 20 March, and then held the entire map for 8 months and 25 days, interrupted only for roughly three days in March. At its height it counted 37–40 member guilds.

Strain had shown all year. [[Fantasy]] left in late May 2018 and fought the bloc across the map all summer — over 220 territories were exchanged — before rejoining on 29 October. The Hive left about a month before the end, then Odysseia. Map-data analysis shows several separate wars between member guilds all igniting on 1 November 2018: the pre-collapse fraying.

## The collapse

At around 3 AM EST on 10 November 2018 one guild left the Federation, and the rest cascaded out within a day. Per the 'R.i.p Fed' thread, [[Imperial]]'s exit 'snowballed into a major attack together with the enemy alliance'; Arisen followed; and after 14 hours of constant warring the [[Aesir Pact]] guilds — Sins of Seedia, [[DiamondDeities]] and IceBlue Team, the Federation's last defenders — quit, ending it. The Aesir Pact died with the alliance it defended.

Drew1011 posted a tribute three days later: 'What killed Federation was... internal affairs.'

## Aftermath

The community timeline describes the winter 2018–19 interregnum simply: 'After Fed all guilds keep to themselves with valk owning most of Gavel' — [[Valkyrie]]'s guilds, Kingdom Foxes and Imperial, being the interregnum's top territory gainers in exchange data. [[sol|SOL]] was created in the post-collapse chaos, and [[Luna]] formed on 14 February 2019 to counter it, opening [[the-alliance-wars-of-2019|the alliance wars of 2019]].

## Sources

- 'R.i.p Fed', Wynncraft forums thread 236962 (Nov 2018) — the collapse sequence
- Community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ, via forums thread 265297)
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (1 Nov intra-bloc war ignition; interregnum gainers)

articles.title: The Great Collapse
articles.summary: On 11 May 2021, Goose and Artemis — the two blocs that had fought the war for the map — both collapsed on the same day. Thirteen guilds formed Valhalla and nine formed Khaos, and the new blocs went straight to war.
articles.body:
The Great Collapse is the name given to 11 May 2021, the day [[Goose]] and [[Artemis]] both collapsed and the guild world reorganized into [[Valhalla]] and [[Khaos]] — ending the [[artemis-goose-era|Artemis-Goose era]] and beginning the Valhalla one.

{{map:2021-05-11|The map on the day of the collapse}}

## Background

The [[goose-artemis-war|Goose-Artemis war]] had run since December 2020: Artemis the map-holder, Goose the coalition that rose against it and eventually took map control. By May 2021 Goose had absorbed much of the old Artemis world along with the guilds that would become Khaos's core.

## The collapse

On 11 May 2021 both alliances dissolved on the same day. Thirteen guilds — including [[The Aquarium]] — formed Valhalla, while nine, largely the Goose bloc's core (Aequitas, Wheres The Finish, Nerfuria, Ultra Violet, Fuzzy Spiders, ChinaNumberOne, Cyphrus Code, Eden, with Tartarus Wrath joining days later), formed Khaos. Valhalla took map control from Goose's remnants within days.

The only surviving written account is brief. A megalist post of 25 May 2021 records that 'the two major alliances both disbanded and got new names... Valhalla and Kaos', while noting that [[Valkyrie]] 'stayed the same'. No public rosters of the new blocs were ever posted; the chronicle's rosters derive from the community Timeline document. Why both alliances fell on the same day is not recorded.

## Aftermath

The [[valhalla-khaos-war|Valhalla-Khaos war]] began the day both blocs formed and outlived them both in their original shapes. The collapse also fixed the shape of guild politics for the following year: Valhalla's line ran through [[Vanir]] to the great 2022 realignment, and Khaos's guilds were eventually absorbed into [[Cucumber Company]].

## Sources

- Community Timeline document (chronicle import) — the 11 May 2021 double collapse and successor rosters
- Wynncraft forums thread 278112 ('the megalist'), Dream's post of 25 May 2021 (via Wayback) — independent corroboration of the disband-and-rename
- Chronicle alliance records: Goose, Artemis, Valhalla, Khaos

articles.title: The Long Raid
articles.summary: A roughly week-long siege of Aequitas's claim in the Sky province, late July to early August 2024 — the only battle of its era with a first-person retelling, the video 'Wynncraft Warring - The Long Raid' by Frank Wynncraft. The attackers are never named in any surviving text.

articles.body:
The Long Raid was a roughly week-long siege of [[Aequitas]]'s claim in the Sky province in late July and early August 2024. It is the only battle of [[private-diplomacy-era|its era]] with a first-person retelling: the video 'Wynncraft Warring - The Long Raid' by Frank Wynncraft, which premiered on 4 August 2024, followed by a forum retelling posted on 9 August 2024 by Defervesco.

{{map:2024-07-28|The map during the siege}}

## Background

The raid falls inside the window of the [[idiot-co-aquarium-war|Idiot Co-Aquarium war]], the era's dominant conflict, but is described in the retelling as small-guild warfare rather than part of that war's main front.

## Course of the war

The attackers besieged Aequitas's Sky-province claim for about a week. Beyond the siege's shape and duration, the record is thin: the attackers are never named in any indexed text, and the outcome is not recorded. No war chart is shown because only one belligerent is known.

## Aftermath

Nothing further is recorded. The raid's significance to the historical record is chiefly documentary — a rare first-person account from a period when almost all guild diplomacy and war reporting had moved to private channels. Frank Wynncraft's other 'Wynncraft Warring' episodes remain an unenumerated lead for future research.

articles.title: The wipe of HackForums
articles.summary: On 19 February 2018, three days after forming, the Federation attacked HackForums' 111 territories and wiped them to zero in under 12 hours — the end of Hax as a territorial power, a year after its 2017 peak of roughly 350 territories.

infobox.label: Outcome
infobox.value: HackForums reduced from 111 territories to zero in under 12 hours

articles.body:
The wipe of HackForums was a one-day operation on 19 February 2018 in which the newly formed [[the-federation|Federation]] attacked [[HackForums]]' 111 territories and took every one of them in under 12 hours. It ended Hax's years as a territorial power.

{{map:2018-02-19|The map on the day of the wipe}}

## Background

HackForums was the dominant territorial guild of the mid-2010s. A recovered Wayback capture of the guild leaderboard from 23 September 2016 shows Hax holding 146 of roughly 332 held territories — more than double the next guild, [[Libertas]] (60), with UltimateXeons third (53). Written accounts put its 2017 peak near 350 territories at the head of the Hax & Co mega-alliance, whose fall was remembered as 'the biggest event of 2017'. No exchange-level war data survives from that era; the pre-2018 record consists of leaderboard captures, forum imagery and written accounts.

By early 2018 Hax was a member of the [[Coalition]], and on 16–17 February 2018 it left with the breakaway [[Alliance Alliance]] bloc, starting the [[coalition-civil-war|Coalition Civil War]]. The Federation — formed from the Coalition remnant and War Syndicate's remains — was three days old when it struck.

## Course of the war

The community timeline records it in one line: on 19 February 2018 the Federation attacked Hax's 111 territories 'and wipes them to 0 in under 12 hours'. No fuller account of the fighting survives.

A war chart is not shown here because the attacker was a multi-guild alliance rather than a single guild.

## Aftermath

The wipe ended HackForums as a territorial power a year after its peak. The guild itself survived: a March 2019 leaderboard capture shows it back at 33 territories, and it later appears as a member of [[Valhalla]] (2021) and the [[Hestia]] community alliance (attested June 2021) — but the record never again shows it near its 2016–17 scale.

## Sources

- Community guild-timeline image (imgur seklYAQ, via Wynncraft forums thread 265297)
- Wayback Machine captures of the Wynncraft guild leaderboard API, 23 Sep 2016 and 3 Mar 2019 (pre-2018 territory snapshots)
- 'Federation Tribute' by Drew1011, Wynncraft forums thread 237070 (13 Nov 2018)
- Chronicle alliance records: Federation, Valhalla, Hestia

articles.title: Valhalla-Khaos war
articles.summary: The war between the two successor blocs of the Great Collapse, begun 11 May 2021 — the day both formed — and fading only in spring 2022. Vanir inherited Valhalla's side mid-war, and the realignment that followed produced Cucumber Company.

infobox.label: Outcome
infobox.value: No recorded peace; fighting faded by mid-July 2022 and the blocs merged into [[Cucumber Company]]

articles.body:
The Valhalla-Khaos war began on 11 May 2021, the day both blocs emerged from [[the-great-collapse|The Great Collapse]], and ran — through renames, betrayals and collapses on the Valhalla side — until the fighting faded to nothing in 2022.

{{map:2021-05-11|The map when the war began}}

## Background

[[Valhalla]] formed from thirteen guilds including [[The Aquarium]]; [[Khaos]] formed the same day, largely from the [[Goose]] bloc's core: [[Aequitas]], Wheres The Finish, Nerfuria, Ultra Violet, Fuzzy Spiders, ChinaNumberOne, Cyphrus Code and Eden, joined days later by Tartarus Wrath. Valhalla took map control from Goose's remnants within days and dominated the map through 2021 — a September 2021 thread describes joining Valhalla as 'the meta' for leaderboard guilds.

## Course of the war

Exchange data shows sustained fighting — roughly a thousand exchanges a week at its peaks — continuing from May 2021 into spring 2022.

The Valhalla side changed shape mid-war. In late 2021 The Mage Legacy and TheNoLifes turned on their allies ([[the-federation-dies|not the first bloc]] to die of internal strain): friction was visible from August, and both were excluded when ten Valhalla guilds reorganized as [[Vanir]] on 28 November 2021. The betrayal erupted into open war in December — 5,359 quiet-territory exchanges that month — and per testimony TheNoLifes went on to help lead Khaos. Vanir itself collapsed on 18 December 2021, twenty days after forming, when Emorians, Nefarious Ravens, IceBlue Team and [[Avicia]] left.

Khaos fought on against the ex-Valhalla/Vanir guilds — an opposing coalition remembered in testimony as 'the Pineapple Pact', a name with no surviving written record. This final phase peaked in January 2022 at 500–800 quiet-territory exchanges per week and faded through spring to nothing by mid-July 2022.

No war chart is shown: this was a bloc-level war between multi-guild alliances throughout.

## Aftermath

No peace was ever recorded. Khaos was defunct by 26 June 2022, when the megalist's new alliance listing replaced the old one; its guilds were absorbed into [[Cucumber Company]], the merged mega-bloc of [[the-realignment-era|the 2022 realignment]] that united the ex-Valhalla and ex-Khaos worlds.

## Sources

- Community Timeline document (chronicle import) — formation of both blocs, 11 May 2021
- Wynncraft forums thread 295680 (IamFye, 25 Sep 2021) — Valhalla's dominance
- Wynncraft forums thread 278112 ('the megalist'), posts of 25 May 2021 and 26 Jun 2022 (via Wayback)
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (weekly volumes; December 2021 eruption; Jan–Jul 2022 fade)
- Cameron oral history (testimony: TheNoLifes' Khaos leadership; 'Pineapple Pact')

articles.title: Vanir collapses
articles.summary: On 18 Dec 2021 Emorians, Nefarious Ravens, IceBlue Team and Avicia left Vanir and the alliance collapsed, twenty days after forming. Niflheim officially dissolved the same day.

infobox.label: Triggered by
infobox.value: [[Emorians]], Nefarious Ravens, IceBlue Team and [[Avicia]] leaving

articles.body:
[[Vanir]] was formed on 28 Nov 2021 by ten [[Valhalla]] guilds — including [[The Aquarium]] — as a reorganization of the bloc that had dominated the map since May. Guardian of Wynn and Nefarious Ravens were invited on 1 Dec. It did not survive its first month.

## The collapse

On 18 Dec 2021 [[Emorians]], Nefarious Ravens, IceBlue Team and [[Avicia]] left, and the alliance collapsed — twenty days after forming. No written account explains the departures; the record preserves only the fact of them. [[Niflheim]], the community alliance that had run alongside the war blocs since 2020, officially dissolved the same day.

{{map:2021-12-18|The map on the day Vanir collapsed}}

## Aftermath

Vanir's fall left the ex-Valhalla world without a named alliance while the [[Valhalla-Khaos war]] still ran. The former members fought on against [[Khaos]] through the winter as an unnamed coalition — remembered in testimony as "the Pineapple Pact", though no written record of that name survives ([[khaos-s-last-war|Khaos's last war]]). The realignment that followed in spring 2022 produced [[Cucumber Company]], which reunited most of Vanir's guilds with their former Khaos enemies. Vanir proved to be the last formally-announced successor of the Valhalla line.

## Sources

- community Timeline document (the founding, invitations, and the 18 Dec departures)
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (the continuing winter war)

articles.title: Aequitas
articles.summary: Wynncraft guild founded in late 2019; a Goose guild, co-founder of Khaos, and member of Cucumber Company and smtn elf. Defender in the Long Raid of 2024, belligerent in the largest recorded war (against Avicia, 2025), and driven to zero territories in the ongoing 2026 war with Sequoia.
articles.body:
Aequitas [Aeq] is a Wynncraft guild created on 24 Nov 2019.

## History

### Goose and Khaos (2021-2022)

Aequitas enters the alliance record in spring 2021 as part of [[Goose]], attested among the coalition's later additions by 30 Mar 2021. The chronicle also records a brief [[Artemis]] stint in the war's final week (early May 2021) while still listed with Goose — an overlap the record leaves unresolved. At [[the-great-collapse|the Great Collapse]] of 11 May 2021 Aequitas co-founded [[Khaos]] with the Goose bloc's core, fighting the [[valhalla-khaos-war|war against Valhalla and Vanir]] that peaked in January 2022; Khaos was defunct by 26 Jun 2022 and its guilds were absorbed into [[Cucumber Company]].

### The super-alliance years (2022-2023)

Aequitas appears in Cucumber Company's 14-guild megalist roster of 26 Jun 2022 and carried through into [[smtn elf]] until the alliance's quiet end in mid-2023. In September 2023 a forum post recorded that 'TNL and AEQ were allied and warring together' — the only named relationship of its kind in that era's written record.

### The Long Raid and the great wars (2024-2026)

In late July 2024 Aequitas's claim in the Sky province endured [[the-long-raid|a roughly week-long siege]] — the only battle of its era with a first-person retelling, the video 'Wynncraft Warring - The Long Raid' (premiered 4 Aug 2024). The attackers are never named in any surviving text. From 3 Nov to 21 Dec 2025 Aequitas fought [[Avicia]] in [[aequitas-avicia-war|the largest war in the entire territory record]] (15,710 quiet-territory exchanges). After a one-week clash in August 2025 and spring 2026 skirmishes, [[aequitas-sequoia-war|full war with Sequoia]] erupted in the week of 24 Aug 2026 — 7,488 quiet-territory exchanges in its first week, with Aequitas driven to zero territories. That war is ongoing.

## Alliances

- [[Goose]] — by 30 Mar 2021 – 11 May 2021
- [[Artemis]] — early May 2021 – 11 May 2021 (brief overlapping stint; unresolved in the record)
- [[Khaos]] — 11 May 2021 – defunct by 26 Jun 2022 (co-founder)
- [[Cucumber Company]] — spring 2022 – Sep 2022
- [[smtn elf]] — Sep 2022 – Jun 2023

## Sources

- Chronicle alliance records; Goose fanart roster posts of 30 Mar and 6 Apr 2021
- Wynncraft forums thread 278112 ('the megalist'), post of 26 Jun 2022
- Wynncraft forums thread 280525 p22 (1 Sep 2023, TNL-AEQ)
- 'Wynncraft Warring - The Long Raid' by Frank Wynncraft (4 Aug 2024) and thread 318070 (9 Aug 2024)
- territory_exchanges map-data analysis (2025 and 2026 wars); official API territory count (Sep 2026)

articles.title: Avicia
articles.summary: Wynncraft guild founded in 2018. The last guild standing when Luna wiped the map in 2019's alliance wars, a member of Goose, Niflheim, Valhalla, Vanir, Cucumber Company, Adonis and smtn elf, half of the Avocado Aquarium pact, and a belligerent in the largest war ever recorded, against Aequitas in 2025.
articles.body:
Avicia [AVO] is a Wynncraft guild created on 1 Aug 2018.

## History

### The Luna era (2019)

Avicia enters the war record in July 2019, during [[the-alliance-wars-of-2019|the alliance wars of 2019]]: when [[Luna]] wiped every other guild from the map, Avicia was the last power standing, and by joining Luna on 17 Jul 2019 it completed Luna's full map control. Six weeks later, on 29 Aug 2019, Avicia and [[Emorians]] left after a leadership dispute and declared war on [[Imperial]], spiralling into a large war over Gavel out of which [[Terra]] emerged.

### Goose, Valhalla and Vanir (2020-2021)

Avicia appears in the attested 18 Dec 2020 list of the anti-[[Artemis]] coalition that became [[Goose]], and stayed until [[the-great-collapse|the Great Collapse]] of 11 May 2021, when it co-founded [[Valhalla]]. It also belonged to the community alliance [[Niflheim]] (roster attested July 2021). On 28 Nov 2021 it followed Valhalla into [[Vanir]] — and on 18 Dec 2021 it was one of the four guilds whose departure collapsed it, the same day Niflheim dissolved.

### Super-alliances and the Avocado split (2022-2024)

Avicia joined [[Cucumber Company]] for Season 5 of 2022 and carried through into [[smtn elf]], while also joining the community alliance [[Adonis]] by 12 Jun 2022. In June 2023 it quit smtn elf with [[The Aquarium]] over claim-shrinking pressure; the pair fought on as the [[Avocado Aquarium]] pact into early 2024. From 30 Oct 2023 Avicia waged [[avicia-sequoia-war|war on the young Sequoia]], with a second round in January 2024.

### The Aequitas war (2025)

From 3 Nov to 21 Dec 2025 Avicia fought [[Aequitas]] in [[aequitas-avicia-war|the largest war in the entire territory record]] — 15,710 quiet-territory exchanges (21,526 total), with a weekly peak of 4,736. It was over by Christmas.

## Alliances

- [[Luna]] — 17 Jul 2019 – 29 Aug 2019
- [[Goose]] — by 18 Dec 2020 – 11 May 2021
- [[Niflheim]] — by 7 Jul 2021 – 18 Dec 2021 (community alliance)
- [[Valhalla]] — 11 May 2021 – 28 Nov 2021 (founding member)
- [[Vanir]] — 28 Nov 2021 – 18 Dec 2021
- [[Cucumber Company]] — spring 2022 – Sep 2022
- [[Adonis]] — by 12 Jun 2022 – Mar 2024 (last attestation; community alliance)
- [[smtn elf]] — Sep 2022 – Jun 2023
- [[Avocado Aquarium]] — Jun 2023 – Feb 2024

articles.title: DiamondDeities
articles.summary: Federation-era guild formed in April 2018 as the renamed LE Flowers; Aesir Pact member, SOL and Terra belligerent, Council of Canyon Kingdoms member, and co-founder of Horologium. Disbanded by its leader Nitrogen2Oxygen on 8 Jan 2020, with most members regrouping as Lux Nova.
articles.body:
DiamondDeities [DDT] existed for under two years but touched six chronicled alliances.

## History

### Federation and Aesir (2018)

DiamondDeities emerged on 8 Apr 2018 when the [[the-federation|Federation]] guild LE Flowers was renamed — a rename chain verified by abutting activity windows in the exchange data. It served the Federation until the end, having been accepted into the [[Aesir Pact]] on 18 Jul 2018; the Aesir guilds were the Federation's last defenders on 10-11 Nov 2018, quitting after 14 hours of constant warring.

### SOL and the wars of 2019

After the collapse, map inference places DiamondDeities in [[SOL]], the war alliance born from the Federation's ashes (no written roster of SOL survives). Its peace with [[Kingdom Foxes]] — the Treaty of Rodoroc — took effect on 2 Mar 2019, and the community timeline records a late-2018 deal to share Molten Heights with Fox. The March 2019 capture shows it at 15 territories. That autumn it fought with [[Terra]] against [[Luna]] and joined the [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]], leaving on 21 Nov 2019, two days before the alliance collapsed.

### Horologium and the end (1 Dec 2019 - 8 Jan 2020)

On 1 Dec 2019 DiamondDeities co-founded [[Horologium]] with [[Titans Valor]] and [[The Simple Ones]]. On 8 Jan 2020 [[nitrogen2oxygen|Nitrogen2Oxygen]] disbanded the guild, taking Horologium down with it; most remaining members regrouped as Lux Nova the next day. The API today still answers for the name with a single-member guild dated 8 Apr 2018; the chronicle records the 2020 dissolution, and the discrepancy is unresolved.

## Alliances

- [[the-federation|Federation]] — Apr 2018 – 10-11 Nov 2018 (as DiamondDeities; LE Flowers before the rename)
- [[Aesir Pact]] — 18 Jul 2018 – 10-11 Nov 2018
- [[SOL]] — late 2018 – last attested Jun 2019 (roster map-inferred)
- [[Terra]] — 30 Aug 2019 – 15 Sep 2019 (roster largely map-inferred)
- [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]] — 15 Sep 2019 – 21 Nov 2019 (co-founder)
- [[Horologium]] — 1 Dec 2019 – 8 Jan 2020 (co-founder)

articles.title: Emorians
articles.summary: Wynncraft guild founded in December 2017: a Coalition and Alliance Alliance guild, Federation and Valkyrie member, Luna founder whose August 2019 revolt with Avicia broke the alliance open, later a Goose, Hestia, Valhalla and Vanir guild — and one of the four whose exit collapsed Vanir.
articles.body:
Emorians [ERN] was created on 17 Dec 2017 and was in the thick of alliance politics within weeks.

## History

### Coalition to Federation (2017-2018)

By the turn of 2018 Emorians was in the [[Coalition]] (membership inferred from its documented departure). On 17 Feb 2018 it left with four other guilds to co-found [[Alliance Alliance]], fighting the [[coalition-civil-war|Coalition Civil War]]; when the war ended it was absorbed into [[the-federation|the Federation]], where it stayed until [[the-federation-dies|the collapse of 10 Nov 2018]]. It also joined the [[Valkyrie]] community alliance on 23 May 2018.

### Luna and the revolt (2019)

Emorians was a founder of [[Luna]] on 14 Feb 2019. The March 2019 capture shows it as the map's second-largest holder at 61 territories. On 29 Aug 2019, after a leadership dispute, Emorians and [[Avicia]] left Luna and declared war on [[Imperial]] — the revolt that spiralled into a large war over Gavel, out of which [[Terra]] formed and Luna ultimately fell.

### The blocs of the 2020s

Emorians appears in the attested 18 Dec 2020 anti-[[Artemis]] coalition list that became [[Goose]], staying until [[the-great-collapse|the Great Collapse]] of 11 May 2021, then joined [[Valhalla]] at its founding and followed it into [[Vanir]]. On 18 Dec 2021 it was one of the four guilds whose departure collapsed Vanir after twenty days. It was also attested in the community alliance [[Hestia]] by 6 Jun 2021, in the record until Hestia's last attestation in September 2022.

## Alliances

- [[the-federation|Federation]] — 20 Mar 2018 – 10 Nov 2018

- [[Vanir]] — 28 Nov 2021 – 18 Dec 2021

articles.title: Fantasy
articles.summary: Wynncraft guild of the Federation era: co-founder of Alliance Alliance and of the Aesir Pact, and the guild that turned on the dominant Federation in mid-2018, exchanging over 220 territories with the bloc before rejoining it weeks before the collapse. Last chronicled in the Council of Canyon Kingdoms in late 2019.
articles.body:
Fantasy [Fux], created on 19 Jul 2017, is chiefly remembered for one of the boldest acts of [[federation-era|the Federation era]]: going to war, alone, against the alliance that held the entire map.

## History

### Alliance Alliance and Aesir (early 2018)

Fantasy co-founded [[Alliance Alliance]] on 17 Feb 2018 alongside the five guilds leaving the [[Coalition]], fighting the [[coalition-civil-war|Coalition Civil War]] until [[the-federation|the Federation]] took the map on 20 Mar 2018 and absorbed the AA guilds. Five days later Fantasy co-created the [[Aesir Pact]] with [[Sins of Seedia]] and IceBlue Team — a pact of sister guilds 'especially dedicated to Gavel', led by Viaire among others.

### The lone war (mid-2018)

Map analysis places Fantasy's departure from the Federation in the week of 28 May 2018, when off-FFA fighting jumps to sustained war levels. It fought the dominant bloc across the map all summer — over 220 territories were exchanged — before rejoining on 29 Oct 2018. Oddly, the Aesir Pact evidently survived Fantasy's rebellion against the alliance that contained it; no source resolves the contradiction. Twelve days after the rejoin the Federation [[the-federation-dies|cascaded apart]], and the Aesir guilds, its last defenders, quit after 14 hours of constant warring — Aesir died with it. The April 2018 leaderboard capture shows Fantasy at 27 territories.

### 2019 and after

In 2019 Fantasy fought with [[Terra]] against [[Luna]] (roster largely map-inferred) and co-founded the [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]] on 15 Sep 2019, staying to its collapse on 23 Nov 2019. After that the guild disappears from the alliance record entirely.

## Alliances

- [[Alliance Alliance]] — 17 Feb 2018 – 20 Mar 2018 (co-founder)
- [[the-federation|Federation]] — 20 Mar – ~28 May 2018 (exit map-inferred); 29 Oct – 10 Nov 2018
- [[Aesir Pact]] — 25 Mar 2018 – 10-11 Nov 2018 (co-founder)
- [[Terra]] — 30 Aug 2019 – 15 Sep 2019 (roster largely map-inferred)
- [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]] — 15 Sep 2019 – 23 Nov 2019 (co-founder)

articles.title: HackForums
articles.summary: The dominant power of pre-2018 Wynncraft warring: the September 2016 API capture shows HackForums holding 146 of the map's ~332 territories, and written accounts put its 2017 peak near 350. The Federation wiped its 111 remaining territories to zero in under 12 hours in February 2018, ending Hax as a territorial power.
articles.body:
HackForums [Hax], created on 24 Dec 2014, was the dominant territorial power of [[early-guild-era|the early guild era]].

## History

### Dominance (2014-2017)

The oldest structured territory data that survives — a Wayback Machine capture of the API guild leaderboard from 23 Sep 2016 — shows HackForums holding 146 of the map's ~332 territories, nearly two and a half times the next guild ([[Libertas]], at 60). Written accounts push its peak higher still: about 350 territories in 2017, at the head of the 'Hax & Co' grouping, whose fall was remembered as 'the biggest event of 2017'. Exchange-level records from this era were never archived; the 2016-2017 wars survive only in forum imagery and written accounts.

### The Coalition and the wipe (2017-2018)

By the end of 2017 HackForums was a member of the [[Coalition]], the alliance holding full map dominance that winter. On 17 Feb 2018 it left with four other guilds to form [[Alliance Alliance]], starting the [[coalition-civil-war|Coalition Civil War]]. Two days later, on 19 Feb 2018, the newly formed [[the-federation|Federation]] attacked HackForums' 111 territories and [[the-wipe-of-hackforums|wiped them to zero in under 12 hours]] — the end of Hax as a territorial power, a year after its peak.

### After the fall

The guild endured. The 3 Mar 2019 capture shows it back at 33 territories, at guild level 82 with the largest roster on the leaderboard (84 members). In 2021 it joined [[Valhalla]] at its founding, and it was attested in the community alliance [[Hestia]] by 6 Jun 2021, remaining in the record until Hestia's last attestation in September 2022.

articles.body:
Idiot Co [ICo] is a Wynncraft guild created on 26 Nov 2017.

## History

### The quiet years (2017-2022)

For most of its first five years Idiot Co left little trace in the written alliance record. Its first appearance in the corpus is a 20 Feb 2021 forum post naming ICo among the guilds actively warring in the desert during the [[goose-artemis-war|Goose-Artemis war]] — which side, the post does not say.

### smtn elf (2023)

Idiot Co joined [[smtn elf]], the great super-alliance descended from [[Cucumber Company]], by late March 2023; [[titan-times|Titan Times]] vol. 9 (25 Mar 2023) records it holding alliance territory. It remained until the alliance quietly dissolved in mid-2023 after [[The Aquarium]] and [[Avicia]] walked out.

### The Aquarium war (2024-2025)

On 29 Apr 2024 Idiot Co ignited [[idiot-co-aquarium-war|the biggest war since 2021]] against The Aquarium, raging through mid-July with a peak of 5,045 quiet-territory exchanges in a single week, and returning for a second round from November 2024 into January 2025. The war spanned the Rekindled World map rework of 10 Aug 2024. As with all wars of [[private-diplomacy-era|the private-diplomacy era]], any wider coalitions involved have no written record; only the two principal guilds are named by the data.

articles.title: Imperial
articles.summary: Wynncraft guild founded in January 2015; co-founder of the Valkyrie alliance, Federation member whose exit helped trigger the 2018 collapse, founder of Luna and of Artemis, and later a member of the Goose coalition. The largest territory holder on the map in the March 2019 capture.
articles.body:
Imperial [Imp] is one of the oldest guilds in the warring record, created on 14 Jan 2015.

## History

### Valkyrie and the Federation (2015-2018)

On 2 Jun 2015 Imperial co-founded [[Valkyrie]] with Kingdom of Foxes (today [[Kingdom Foxes]]); the research record shows it formally left the alliance in October 2016 and is re-attested as a member from September 2019. Imperial was a member of [[the-federation|the Federation]] from its founding in February 2018 through [[federation-era|the Federation era]]; during the November 2018 collapse its exit 'for independence... snowballed into a major attack together with the enemy alliance', part of the cascade that killed the alliance on 10 Nov 2018.

### Luna and the wars of 2019

Imperial founded [[Luna]] on 14 Feb 2019 to counter [[SOL]], and led its war on Kingdom Foxes, attacking Fox 660 times over five months. The 3 Mar 2019 leaderboard capture shows Imperial as the map's largest holder, at 85 territories. On 29 Aug 2019 [[Emorians]] and [[Avicia]] left Luna and declared war on Imperial specifically; Luna collapsed that September in the [[Luna]]-[[Terra]] war.

### Artemis, Goose, and the quiet years (2019-2022)

Imperial co-founded [[Artemis]] on 30 Oct 2019 with [[Paladins United]] and Caeruleum Order. By December 2020 it had drifted to the opposing coalition — it is attested in the 18 Dec 2020 list of anti-Artemis guilds that became [[Goose]] — and remained there until [[the-great-collapse|the Great Collapse]] of 11 May 2021. No war-bloc membership is recorded after 2021; Valkyrie was last attested, with Imperial a member, on 19 Sep 2022.

articles.body:
Kingdom Foxes [Fox] carries one of the longest continuous histories in Wynncraft guild warfare, spanning [[early-guild-era|the early guild era]] to the 2020s.

## History

### Kingdom of Foxes and Valkyrie (2015-2017)

Early records name 'Kingdom of Foxes' as co-founder, with [[Imperial]], of [[Valkyrie]] on 2 Jun 2015 — an alliance created 'not for the purpose of war', governed by an Electorate of guild masters, that became the longest-lived in Wynncraft history. The guild listed in the API today was created on 3 Jul 2016; whether that was a rename or a re-creation of the 2015 guild is not recorded. In October 2017 Kingdom Foxes co-founded the [[Coalition]] with KingdomPhoenixes, Gilded Sparrows and House of Sentinels; the Coalition took the Wynn Province on 23 Nov 2017, wiped War Syndicate on Christmas Day, and gained full map dominance.

### The Federation era (2018)

When five guilds split off in February 2018, starting the [[coalition-civil-war|Coalition Civil War]], Kingdom Foxes went with the Coalition remnant into [[the-federation|the Federation]] and remained until [[the-federation-dies|its collapse on 10 Nov 2018]]. The April 2018 leaderboard capture shows Fox as the map's largest holder, at 82 territories. In the winter interregnum that followed, the community timeline records 'valk owning most of Gavel'.

### The wars of 2019

[[Luna]] fought Kingdom Foxes across 300+ territories from 15 Feb 2019 — Imperial alone attacked Fox 660 times. Peace came stepwise: the Treaty of Rodoroc with [[DiamondDeities]] took effect 2 Mar 2019, and the Treaty of Ternaves (6 Jul 2019) split the dissolved Celestial Tigers' land; Fox joined Luna on 8 Jul 2019. Its departure on 18 Sep 2019 collapsed Luna. Three days earlier it had co-founded the [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]], which it left on 2 Nov 2019.

### Artemis and after (2020-2022)

By March 2020 Kingdom Foxes was an attested member of [[Artemis]], remaining through [[the-great-collapse|the Great Collapse]] of 11 May 2021. It joined [[Cucumber Company]] in spring 2022; map data dates its exit to early July 2022, after which it fought its former bloc. Valkyrie was last attested, with Fox still a member, on 19 Sep 2022.

articles.title: Libertas
articles.summary: A major territorial power of 2016 recovered entirely from a single archived API capture: 60 territories on 23 Sep 2016, second only to HackForums — and absent from every written source that survives.
articles.body:
Libertas [Lir] is known to history from exactly one document: a Wayback Machine capture of Wynncraft's v1 API guild leaderboard, taken at 22:10 UTC on 23 Sep 2016.

## History

### A power recovered from the archive

The capture records Libertas holding 60 territories — nearly a fifth of the ~332-territory map, second only to [[HackForums]]' 146 and ahead of UltimateXeons' 53 — at guild level 59 with 57 members. In the era of [[territory-warfare|territory warfare]] that predates any exchange log, that number marks a first-rank power.

No written source mentions it. No forum thread, alliance roster, newsletter, memoir, or community timeline names Libertas; among the major holders of the 2016 capture it is uniquely undocumented. A guild controlling a large share of the world was, as far as the written record of [[early-guild-era|the early guild era]] is concerned, invisible.

### What cannot be known

Exchange-level war data from before January 2018 was never archived anywhere public, so Libertas' wars, allies, enemies, rise, and fall are all unrecoverable. By the next recovered capture (16 Apr 2018) it is gone from the leaderboard entirely — all fifteen holders that day were [[the-federation|Federation]] guilds. Whether it fell to HackForums' bloc, to the [[Coalition]]'s rise, or simply dissolved is unknown; the record is silent even on its founding. The Wynncraft API today lists a guild named Libertas with the same tag, created on 23 Jul 2018 with nine members; whether it has any connection to the 2016 power is unrecorded.

## Alliances

No alliance membership for Libertas is recorded in any surviving source.

articles.title: Paladins United

articles.body:
Paladins United [PUN], created on 2 Jun 2017, belonged to more chronicled alliances than nearly any guild in the record.

## History

### The Coalition and the Federation (2017-2018)

By late 2017 Paladins United was in the [[Coalition]]. On 17 Feb 2018 it left with four other guilds to co-found [[Alliance Alliance]], starting the [[coalition-civil-war|Coalition Civil War]]; when the war ended on 20 Mar 2018 the AA guilds were absorbed into [[the-federation|the Federation]], where PUN served two stints (to June, and from August until [[the-federation-dies|the collapse of 10 Nov 2018]]).

### Side-switch and the blocs (2020-2023)

By December 2020 PUN had drifted from Artemis to the opposing coalition — it appears in the attested 18 Dec 2020 anti-Artemis list that became [[Goose]] — and stayed until [[the-great-collapse|the Great Collapse]] of 11 May 2021, then joined [[Valhalla]] at its founding and followed it into [[Vanir]]. articles.title: Profession Heaven
articles.summary: A public profession-XP guild granted neutral status in January 2021 under the joint protection of Goose and Artemis. Its neutrality outlived both protectors and every successor alliance, ending only in May 2026 when KongoBoys began a sustained campaign against it.
articles.body:
Profession Heaven [PROF] occupies a unique position in the warring record: a guild whose territory was held by treaty rather than by force.

## History

### Neutrality (2021)

Profession Heaven was created on 20 Jan 2021 as a public profession-XP guild. Five days later, on 25 Jan 2021, it was granted neutral status — protected by both [[Goose]] and [[Artemis]], the two warring blocs of the day — and given territory in the Silent Expanse. Its first territory exchange is dated that same day. The arrangement survived [[the-great-collapse|the Great Collapse]] of May 2021 and the successor blocs that followed.

### Inside the super-alliances (2022-2023)

Profession Heaven appears in [[Cucumber Company]]'s 14-guild roster posted to the [[the-forum-megalist|forum megalist]] on 26 Jun 2022 — the last public alliance roster ever — and carried through the renames into [[smtn elf]], remaining until that alliance's quiet dissolution in mid-2023. Through the wars of [[private-diplomacy-era|the private-diplomacy era]] that followed, its land went largely unmolested.

### The fall of neutrality (2026)

On 25 May 2026 KongoBoys — a former Cucumber Company and smtn elf ally — began [[fall-of-profession-heavens-neutrality|a sustained campaign against Profession Heaven]], running as high as 1,700 quiet-territory exchanges a week and ending five years of neutrality. The campaign was ongoing as of the last data in the record.

## Alliances

- [[Cucumber Company]] — spring 2022 – Sep 2022
- [[smtn elf]] — Sep 2022 – Jun 2023

Its 2021 neutrality was a treaty under Goose and Artemis protection, not an alliance membership.

articles.title: Sequoia
articles.summary: Wynncraft guild founded on 14 Oct 2022 that rose to win seven consecutive guild seasons from mid-2024. Its open-source mod produced the first machine-recorded alliance events in June 2026. Fought Avicia in 2023-24 and has been at war with Aequitas since August 2026.
articles.body:
Sequoia [SEQ] is a Wynncraft guild created on 14 Oct 2022, owned by [[gazthecat|GaztheCat]]. It rose during [[private-diplomacy-era|the private-diplomacy era]], when alliance politics had left the public forums, so much of its history is known only from map data and from its own software.

## History

### Rise (2022-2024)

Within its first year Sequoia drew the attention of an established power: [[Avicia]] skirmished with it through spring 2023, and [[avicia-sequoia-war|the main eruption came on 30 Oct - 20 Nov 2023]], peaking at 1,454 quiet-territory exchanges per week, with a second round in January 2024. The war did not slow the guild — from mid-2024 Sequoia won seven consecutive guild seasons.

### The machine record (2026)

Wynncraft's in-game ally system had existed since version 1.20 (20 Jan 2021), but Sequoia's open-source mod made the first machine captures of alliance events in June 2026: Sequoia formed an alliance with Silk Road; Anime Lovers revoked theirs with Sequoia; GaztheCat revoked with Chiefs Of Corkus; and Radiant Roses formed one — [[first-machine-recorded-alliances|the first machine-recorded alliances]]. From 30 Jul 2026 the mod began auto-snapshotting the in-game Diplomacy menu to Sequoia's private backend, a growing machine-readable alliance archive.

### The Aequitas war (2026)

After a one-week clash in August 2025 and spring 2026 skirmishes, [[aequitas-sequoia-war|full war with Aequitas]] erupted in the week of 24 Aug 2026 — 7,488 quiet-territory exchanges in its first week, with Aequitas driven to zero territories. The war is ongoing.

## Alliances

Sequoia appears in none of the twenty-two chronicled alliances of 2015-2024; by its era, alliance rosters had moved to private Discords. Its recorded pacts are in-game Diplomacy alliances captured by its own mod:

- Silk Road — alliance formed, June 2026
- Chiefs Of Corkus — alliance revoked by GaztheCat, June 2026 (formation date unrecorded)
- Anime Lovers — alliance revoked by Anime Lovers, June 2026 (formation date unrecorded)

ShadowFall [Shy] was created on 21 Aug 2017, but enters the written warring record in 2020.

## History

### An Artemis leader (2020)

In March 2020 ShadowFall's GoulartJJ posted on the forums as a leader of [[Artemis]] — the map-holding alliance of the day — placing the guild not just in the bloc but at its top. It joined the community alliance [[Niflheim]] on 27 Dec 2020.

### The side-switch (2021)

### Into The Aquarium's orbit (2023)
