articles.title: Sins of Seedia
articles.summary: Sins of Seedia (SDU) is a Wynncraft guild founded in May 2017 — a Federation-era stalwart and Aesir Pact co-founder in 2018, later a member of Artemis, Cucumber Company and smtn elf, and still active as of 2026.
articles.body:
Sins of Seedia (SDU) was founded on 6 May 2017, per the official guild API. It spans nearly the whole recorded history of alliance warfare, from the Federation era to the present.

## History

### Federation era

Sins of Seedia enters the record as a founding-era member of [[The Federation]] in February 2018. On 25 Mar 2018 it co-founded the [[Aesir Pact]] with [[Fantasy]] and IceBlue Team — a pact of sister guilds "especially dedicated to Gavel, and the birth place of Aesir, the canyon" — with its leader simplyinfinity_ named among the pact's creators. The Aesir guilds were the Federation's last defenders: as [[the-federation-dies|the alliance fell]] on 10–11 Nov 2018, they quit only after fourteen hours of constant warring, and Aesir died with the Federation.

### Later blocs

The alliance record then goes quiet for over two years. Sins of Seedia reappears in [[Artemis]] from March 2021, staying until [[the-great-collapse|the alliance collapsed]] on 11 May 2021. In the 2022 realignment it joined [[Cucumber Company]]; the alliance's full fourteen-guild roster — the last public alliance roster ever posted — was submitted to the forum megalist on 26 Jun 2022 by SDU's own TherapueticLiz. The guild carried through the rename into [[smtn-elf|smtn elf]] and stayed until the alliance's quiet end in June 2023.

As of September 2026 the guild remains active — level 90, around 75 members, led by TherapueticLiz — holding no territories.

## Alliances

- [[The Federation]] — February – November 2018
- [[Aesir Pact]] — co-founder, March – November 2018
- [[Artemis]] — March – May 2021
- [[Cucumber Company]] — spring – autumn 2022
- [[smtn-elf|smtn elf]] — September 2022 – June 2023

articles.title: The Aquarium
articles.summary: Wynncraft guild founded in March 2020, active in territory warfare from its first days. A founding member of Valhalla and Vanir, a member of Cucumber Company and smtn elf, half of the Avocado Aquarium pact, and a principal in the 2024-25 Idiot Co-Aquarium war, the biggest war since 2021.
articles.body:
The Aquarium [TAq] is a Wynncraft guild created on 22 Mar 2020, in the middle of the [[goose-artemis-war|Goose-Artemis war]]; map data records its first territory exchange the following day. Its earliest alignment was never written down — map analysis places its first fighting on the anti-[[Artemis]] side of that war, but no written roster attests any alliance membership before 2021.

## History

### The Valhalla years (2021)

On 11 May 2021, the day of [[the-great-collapse|the Great Collapse]], The Aquarium was one of the thirteen guilds that founded [[Valhalla]], which took map control within days. When Valhalla reorganized as [[Vanir]] on 28 Nov 2021, The Aquarium was among the ten founding guilds; Vanir collapsed twenty days later. Through the following winter it fought in the [[valhalla-khaos-war|war against Khaos]], which peaked in January 2022 and faded by mid-July — the run-up to [[the-realignment-era|the realignment]].

### Cucumber Company to the Avocado split (2022-2024)

For guild Season 5 (spring 2022) The Aquarium joined [[Cucumber Company]], appearing in the 14-guild roster posted to the [[the-forum-megalist|forum megalist]] on 26 Jun 2022 — the last public alliance roster ever — and carried through the alliance's renames into [[smtn elf]]. In June 2023 it and [[Avicia]] walked out, rejecting pressure to shrink their claims, and as the two-guild [[Avocado Aquarium]] pact the pair waged [[the-avocado-split|a sniping and claim-taking campaign]] against their former allies into early 2024, running shared infrastructure including the joint subguild Avoquarium [HQs] and the subguild [[ShadowFall]].

### The Idiot Co war (2024-2025)

From 29 Apr 2024 The Aquarium fought [[Idiot Co]] in [[idiot-co-aquarium-war|the biggest war since 2021]] — a weekly peak of 5,045 quiet-territory exchanges — through mid-July 2024, with a second round from November 2024 into January 2025, spanning the Rekindled World map rework of 10 Aug 2024.

articles.title: The Simple Ones
articles.summary: Wynncraft guild founded in February 2019 whose defection from Luna to Terra decided the war for the map in September 2019. Later a Horologium co-founder, half of the Empire of Nemract political union, a Valhalla and Vanir guild, and a smtn elf member.
articles.body:
The Simple Ones [ILQ] was created on 5 Feb 2019, nine days before [[Luna]] formed — and the chronicle carries it as an early Luna member (its join is approximated to the alliance's founding; only its departure is documented).

## History

### The defection that decided a war (2019)

The Simple Ones signed the Treaty of Ternaves on 6 Jul 2019 with [[Kingdom Foxes]] and ThisIsMurica, splitting the territory of the dissolved Celestial Tigers. Two months later came its decisive act in [[the-alliance-wars-of-2019|the alliance wars of 2019]]: on 8 Sep 2019, mid-war, it defected from Luna to [[Terra]] — and Terra took control of the map the same day. It then co-founded the [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]] on 15 Sep 2019, staying to its 23 Nov collapse, and co-founded [[Horologium]] on 1 Dec 2019, which died with [[DiamondDeities]]' disbandment on 8 Jan 2020.

### The Empire of Nemract (2020-2021)

On 17 Aug 2020 The Simple Ones formed the [[Empire of Nemract]], a political union with Mystic Woods later branded 'The Empire of Nemract | ILQ + Aeu', whose empress held court titles ('Empress of Nemract, Queen of Aphelion'). The record goes quiet after August 2021; map data shows the two guilds never fought, so the union may have persisted quietly. On 21 May 2021 ILQ signed the Treaty of Damask, under which Nefarious Ravens declared independence.

### The blocs (2021-2023)

The Simple Ones was a founding member of [[Valhalla]] on 11 May 2021 and followed it into [[Vanir]]. At the start of Season 8 (autumn 2022) it joined the renamed 'Smtn else' — later [[smtn elf]] — remaining until the alliance's quiet end in mid-2023.

articles.title: Titans Valor
articles.summary: Wynncraft guild founded in 2017, member of the Federation, Terra, the Council of Canyon Kingdoms, Horologium, Hestia, Artemis, Valhalla, Vanir, Cucumber Company and smtn elf, and co-founder of Adonis. Its newsletter, the Titan Times, is the principal written source for alliance history from 2022 onward.
articles.body:
Titans Valor [ANO], created on 2 Jul 2017, appears in more chronicled alliances than almost any other guild — and documented much of that history itself through its newsletter, the [[titan-times|Titan Times]].

## History

### Federation and the wars of 2019

Titans Valor cycled through [[the-federation|the Federation]] three times in 2018 (February-May, June-July, and September to the collapse). In 2019 it fought with [[Terra]] against [[Luna]] (roster largely map-inferred), co-founded the [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]] on 15 Sep 2019, left on 21 Nov — two days before the alliance collapsed — and co-founded [[Horologium]] on 1 Dec 2019 with [[DiamondDeities]] and [[The Simple Ones]], which died with DiamondDeities' disbandment on 8 Jan 2020.

### Hestia, Artemis, and the blocs of 2020-2021

From around mid-2020 Titans Valor belonged to the community alliance [[Hestia]]. By 2 Dec 2020 it was attested in [[Artemis]], then 'the war alliance made up of all the current massive land holding guilds', and it stayed through [[the-great-collapse|the Great Collapse]] of 11 May 2021 into [[Valhalla]] and [[Vanir]]. It fought the ex-Valhalla side of [[valhalla-khaos-war|the Khaos war]] into 2022.

### The realignment and Adonis (2022-2024)

Titans Valor joined [[Cucumber Company]] for Season 5 — its newsletter's first volume (8 May 2022) records 'our first season being a part of the new Cucumber Company war alliance' — and carried into [[smtn elf]] until that alliance's quiet death in mid-2023. Around May 2022 its leaders and Empire of Sindria's founded [[Adonis]] as Hestia declined, 'a space for those of us who are still active to hang together'; Adonis was still active in March 2024. The Titan Times ran to at least November 2025, and founder IceResistance's remark that 'real diplomacy happens in private alliance chats' names the defining fact of [[private-diplomacy-era|the private-diplomacy era]].

articles.title: Arkada
articles.summary: Titans Valor's Aedile and "chief negotiator", and author of a near-contemporaneous memoir of the Luna-Terra war of 2019.

infobox.label: Known for
infobox.value: The "Inside Myself" memoir of the [[luna-terra-war|Luna-Terra war]] (Sep 2019)

articles.body:
Arkada (forum name Leonhart_Arkada) was a member of [[titans-valor|Titans Valor]] [ANO], the guild founded by [[IceResistance]], and carried the forum title Aedile - "chief negotiator".

In July 2019 he authored "An Argument Against The Current Monopoly On Territory" (thread 252647, 20 July 2019), describing [[Luna]] as "the four most powerful guilds on Wynn" and comparing its dominance to the [[the-federation|Federation]]'s; [[drew1011|Drew1011]] replied with the era's standard defense of mega-alliance cycles.

Around 14 September 2019, with the [[luna-terra-war|Luna-Terra war]] still in motion, he published "Inside Myself - Recent Wynncraft Guild History" on Wattpad under the alias A_Challenger_Arrives - a near-contemporaneous memoir, written as events unfolded rather than years later. It records that [[Valkyrie]] was "now calling themselves Luna"; that [[Terra]] formed from multiple small alliances merging "nearly 15 guilds", including The Ascendancy in which Titans Valor fought; that Terra's weekend raid conquered all Luna territories except [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]]' within six hours; and that Luna's organized counter-raid of 14 September failed. As a participant's memoir it is partisan by nature, and the chronicle cites it as recollection rather than neutral record - but its closeness to the events makes it the era's most valuable single narrative source.

- Wynncraft forums thread 252647 (Leonhart_Arkada, 20 Jul 2019); Aedile title from the same thread

articles.title: AurumKitsune
articles.summary: "Queen of Phoenixes" who founded KingdomPhoenixes in September 2017, a month before it joined the Coalition's founding circle, and later established the Federation's two-thirds-majority voting rule.
articles.body:
AurumKitsune founded the guild KingdomPhoenixes [PHX], announcing it on the forums on 24 September 2017 (thread 204381) under the title "Queen of Phoenixes". The guild was "officially established" on 23 September 2017 - "We arose from the ashes of a dead guild, and re-birthed the spark that was missing!" - with Whimsy and Thundderr as its first chiefs. One month later KingdomPhoenixes stood among the founder guilds of the [[Coalition]] (created October 2017), making AurumKitsune's brand-new guild part of the founding circle alongside [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]], Gilded Sparrows and House of Sentinels.

Her larger legacy came in the [[the-federation|Federation]] (2018). [[drew1011|Drew1011]]'s "Federation Tribute" (thread 237070, 13 November 2018) credits AurumKitsune with building the alliance's Discord infrastructure and with establishing its two-thirds-majority voting rule - the governance mechanism by which the alliance that held the whole map made its decisions. Her own reply in the tribute thread added: "I still can not believe that I made the logo for fed a meme and it was never changed. Deus Vult!" (14 November 2018).

articles.title: Drew1011
articles.summary: Founder and unofficial leader of the Federation, leader of the Valkyrie alliance (2016-2018), one-day Emperator of the Emperium of Wynn, and the guild community's principal historian.

infobox.label: Guild(s)
infobox.value: Holders of LE (owner, 16 Dec 2015 - 31 Jan 2018); [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]] (King, then Viceroy)

infobox.label: Other titles
infobox.value: Emperator of the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]], 15-16 Oct 2017

articles.body:
Drew1011 is the player recorded as founder and unofficial leader of the [[the-federation|Federation]], the dominant alliance of the [[federation-era|Federation era]], which held the entire territory map for 8 months and 25 days in 2018.

His forum profile (member 2157) preserves an exact title chain across the era's institutions. He owned the guild Holders of LE from 16 December 2015 to 31 January 2018, and co-founded the Halcyon Alliance - a mutual-aid pact between Holders of LE and Yamipanda's ToastedPandas - in June 2016 (thread 130444). On 15 October 2016 he authored the third relaunch of the [[Valkyrie]] alliance (thread 159734, with [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]], Holders of LE and Ha Ha United as members) and held "Leader of Valkyrie Alliance" from that day until 10 March 2018. In Kingdom Foxes he was "King of the Foxes" from 1 December 2016 to 7 February 2017 - matching the guild's 3 December 2016 revival in the community timeline - then "Viceroy of the Foxes" until 7 February 2019. Strangest of all, he was Emperator of the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]] for a single day, 15-16 October 2017 - the day before the alliance fell. No written source explains the one-day reign.

When the Federation formed in February 2018 from the [[Coalition]]'s fracture and merger with [[war-syndicate|War Syndicate]], the record consistently names Drew1011 its founder and leader (his profile: "Founder of the Federation", 16 Feb - 10 Nov 2018) - though not without a rival claim: [[slayne|Slayne]] asserted a causal founder's role via [[alliance-alliance|Alliance Alliance]]'s creation (thread 237070 p3 #45, 14 November 2018).

Three days after [[the-federation-dies|the Federation's collapse]] on 10 November 2018, he posted the "Federation Tribute" (thread 237070, 13 November 2018) - a full roster of its 37 member guilds and the alliance's epitaph: "What killed Federation was... internal affairs." He also maintained on Discord "a massive ongoing written history of the guild community from May 2015 onwards" (his reply in thread 251543, June 2019) - the era's largest known unpublished chronicle.

- Wynncraft forums thread 130444 (Halcyon Alliance, Jun 2016)
- Wynncraft forums thread 159734 ("Valkyrie Alliance" relaunch by Drew1011, 15 Oct 2016)
- Wynncraft forums thread 237070 ("Federation Tribute", 13 Nov 2018; p3 #45 for Slayne's claim)

articles.title: Killerfish
articles.summary: Founder of Gilded Sparrows (November 2017), one of the Coalition's founder guilds, and earlier a council member of House of Sentinels.

infobox.value: Gilded Sparrows (founder, Nov 2017); House of Sentinels (council, 2016)

infobox.label: Known for

Killerfish sat on the 2016 council of House of Sentinels, the guild founded by Pyrias on 2 July 2016 and later led by Pretzule; the guild's thread (135191) lists the council as Pyrias, Pretzule, wrxryuu, Killerfish, ChaChaChaChino and 01100110111.

In November 2017 Killerfish founded the guild Gilded Sparrows, announcing it on 17 November 2017 (thread 208566) as "founded in the midst of autumn", with a single plain rule: "Be relatively active. After 3 weeks of total inactivity, you will be kicked." [[drew1011|Drew1011]] replied the same day: "Good luck with your guild ... they grow up so fast".

Gilded Sparrows became one of the founder guilds of the [[Coalition]] (created October-November 2017), alongside [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]], KingdomPhoenixes and House of Sentinels itself. Killerfish's path - Sentinels council member to founder of a fellow Coalition guild - is direct evidence that the Coalition's founding guilds were socially one circle rather than strangers in a marriage of convenience.

No later roles are attested in the written record.

articles.title: LoveLusting
articles.summary: "Queen of the Foxes" who led Kingdom Foxes in 2015 and authored the founding thread of the Valkyrie alliance in September 2015.
articles.body:
LoveLusting led [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]] (then "Kingdom of Foxes") in the guild's early years, posting on the forums under the title "Queen of the Foxes" (guild thread 89227, September 2015).

On 10 September 2015 she authored the founding thread of the [[Valkyrie]] alliance (thread 89529, "Valkyrie Alliance"), announcing an alliance formed on 2 June 2015 between Kingdom of Foxes and [[Imperial]]. The thread stated it was "not established for the purpose of war" but for "solidifying social relations between the two guilds", and described its governing body, the "Valkyrie Electorate": the member guilds' leaders deciding foreign affairs and policy by "unanimous agreement in their decision-making process". Yuno F Gasai of Imperial was the other figure named in the thread. As the author of the alliance's founding document, LoveLusting is the strongest attested candidate for Valkyrie's founder as an individual, though the thread itself assigns no such title.

Her name recurs three years later: [[drew1011|Drew1011]]'s "Federation Tribute" (thread 237070, 13 November 2018) closes with a personal acknowledgment of LoveLusting, indicating continued standing in the community through the [[federation-era|Federation era]].

articles.title: Nitrogen2Oxygen
articles.summary: Emperator of the Emperium of Wynn (2017), co-leader of DiamondDeities with Icey_Diamond, and the player who disbanded that guild on 8 January 2020, ending Horologium and the alliance wars of 2019.

articles.body:
Nitrogen2Oxygen's attested career spans the era's bookends: he led its first grand experiment in mass alliance and ended its last.

In 2017 he was Emperator of the [[emperium-of-wynn|Emperium of Wynn]], the twelve-guild alliance founded on 21 April 2017: its forum thread (188024) names "Emperator Nitrogen2Oxygen" at the head of the alliance's leadership and among its Judges. The Emperium fell in October 2017; [[drew1011|Drew1011]]'s profile records a one-day successor Emperator on 15-16 October 2017.

He then co-led the guild [[DiamondDeities]] [DDT] with Icey_Diamond: the pair are listed as DDT's leaders in the founding thread of the [[aesir-pact|Aesir Pact]] (thread 227373, 2018), and Drew1011's "Federation Tribute" credits them jointly as "sincere and trusted friends" of the [[the-federation|Federation]]. On the forums he posted under the alias Cloud Man (identified in thread 236962).

On 8 January 2020 he disbanded DiamondDeities - by then a Federation and Aesir Pact veteran, a map-inferred [[SOL]] guild, a Treaty of Rodoroc signatory alongside [[kingdom-foxes|Kingdom Foxes]], and a founder of [[Terra]], the [[Council of Canyon Kingdoms]] and [[Horologium]] (1 December 2019). The disbanding dissolved Horologium the same day and marked the end of [[the-alliance-wars-of-2019|the alliance wars of 2019]]. Most remaining members regrouped as Lux Nova the next day. His role within DDT immediately before the disbanding is not otherwise documented.

simplyinfinity_ led the guild [[sins-of-seedia|Sins of Seedia]] [SDU] through several political generations of the late 2010s.

Sins of Seedia later left the Federation with the other Aesir guilds on 10 November 2018, the departure described by a witness as "essentially ending it"; no source attributes that exit to simplyinfinity_ personally.

articles.title: Slayne
articles.summary: Federation-circle player remembered for a November 2018 forum post claiming he co-created Alliance Alliance - and thereby, indirectly, the Federation itself.
articles.body:
Slayne appears in the written record of the [[federation-era|Federation era]]. [[drew1011|Drew1011]]'s "Federation Tribute" (thread 237070, 13 November 2018) credits him among the [[the-federation|Federation]]'s contributors for loyalty and straightforwardness.

On page 3 of the same thread (post #45, 14 November 2018, posted under the forum title "Tenacious Snuggles") Slayne made the claim for which he is chiefly remembered: "In a way, you could say that I created Fed because I (along with some others) created Double AA. Take that drew! Owait. Im also drew. Damn it".

"Double AA" is [[alliance-alliance|Alliance Alliance]], whose split from the [[Coalition]] on 16 February 2018 triggered the merger of the Coalition remnant and [[war-syndicate|War Syndicate]] that created the Federation - so the post asserts a causal founder's role, jokingly aimed at Drew1011. It is a claim, not an attested founding record: no other source names Alliance Alliance's creators, none contradicts Slayne, and his own wording ("along with some others") leaves the rest of the founding circle unnamed. It stands as the only first-person account of AA's creation.

No guild affiliation for Slayne is recorded in the era's sources.

articles.title: TheDarkSoul
articles.summary: Owner of the war guild HackForums from its creation on 24 December 2014, presiding over its 2016-17 territorial hegemony of up to roughly 350 territories.
articles.body:
TheDarkSoul owned the guild [[HackForums]] [Hax]. The guild's recruitment thread (109319) carried the line "Active Guild Since: 12/24/14 - Owner: TheDarkSoul" in every recovered version, and described the guild plainly: "This is a war guild, guild wars are expected of you upon joining." Day-to-day forum-keeping fell to officers such as Mrussell75 and Christinel8; TheDarkSoul's own written footprint is minimal, and the ownership line is essentially his entire attested record.

Under his ownership HackForums became the dominant territorial power of the pre-[[Coalition]] era. An API leaderboard capture of 23 September 2016 shows Hax holding 146 of roughly 332 territories, far ahead of any rival; a March 2017 complaint thread (179383) put its holdings at "100+ territories"; a May 2017 thread attests more than 300; and a 2020 recollection by Lego_DW places the peak "closer to 350". The hegemony ended in the Coalition-era wars of late 2017 and [[the-wipe-of-hackforums|the wipe of HackForums]] in February 2018.

No written source records when, or whether, his ownership ended.

articles.title: Guild seasons
articles.summary: The competitive season system added in patch 1.20.3 (5 July 2021): guilds earn Season Rating by holding and attacking territories, with rewards and territory resets every season. Seasons became the calendar by which the community dated its own history.

infobox.label: Mechanic
infobox.value: Season Rating (SR) from holding and attacking territories

infobox.label: Season length
infobox.value: 'Every 3 months or so' (announced); in practice roughly 2–3 months

articles.body:
Guild seasons were introduced in patch 1.20.3, released on 5 July 2021, building on the [[territory-warfare|territory warfare]] rework of version 1.20 'Gavel Reborn' (20 January 2021).

Under the system, guilds earn Season Rating (SR) by holding and attacking territories. Seasons conclude 'every 3 months or so', territories reset at each season's end, and rewards are distributed by SR leaderboard ranking, territories held at season's end, and SR thresholds — guild capes, seasonal banners, badges, tomes, emeralds, XP boosts, bank slots, and a crown cosmetic for the #1 guild. The design deliberately spread rewards beyond the top competitive guilds. The same patch reduced war team size from 6 to 5, adjusted tax caps and added territory loadouts.

Seasons quickly became the community's calendar. [[Cucumber Company]] was formed 'for Season 5' in spring 2022; its rename to Smtn else (later [[smtn elf]]) came 'at the start of Season 8' in autumn 2022; [[Avicia]]'s Season 12 crown post of 10 June 2023 is the last recorded mention of smtn elf; and [[Sequoia]] won seven consecutive seasons from mid-2024. Season-end posts by winning guilds are among the era's principal primary sources (see [[titan-times|Titan Times]]). The exact calendar dates of individual season boundaries are not compiled in the chronicle's sources and are approximated where cited.

articles.title: The Diplomacy update
articles.summary: Wynncraft's in-game alliance system dates to version 1.20 (2021), but 2026 made it matter: allied guilds gained shared Guild Raids, and the in-game Diplomacy menu became the first machine-readable record of alliances in guild history.

infobox.label: API status
infobox.value: Official API exposes no alliance field (verified Sep 2026)

articles.body:
Wynncraft has had an in-game guild ally system since version 1.20 'Gavel Reborn' (20 January 2021) — allies interact with the [[territory-warfare|territory system]] through, for example, the ally tax rate on territories, and a Diplomacy menu in the guild UI lists a guild's allies (up to 16, per the Sequoia mod's snapshot feature). For its first five years the system was historically invisible: alliances were made and dissolved in Discords, and no source in the chronicle records the in-game menu mattering to the [[the-realignment-era|realignment-era]] or [[private-diplomacy-era|private-diplomacy-era]] blocs.

That changed in 2026. Version 2.2.1 (12 June 2026) added the change 'Guild Allies can now do Guild Raids together', giving formal alliances a gameplay payoff. (The chronicle database dates this feature to version 2.2.2 of 10 July 2026; the wiki's changelogs attribute it to 2.2.1 — the conflict is noted here, with the wiki's own patch notes favoured.)

The same month, [[Sequoia]]'s open-source client mod began parsing the in-game 'formed/revoked an alliance with' chat broadcasts (commit of 12 June 2026), capturing [[first-machine-recorded-alliances|the first machine-recorded alliance events]] in guild history — including [[GaztheCat]], Sequoia's owner, revoking an alliance with Chiefs Of Corkus. From 30 July 2026 the mod auto-snapshots the Diplomacy menu to Sequoia's private backend, a growing machine-readable alliance archive that is not publicly accessible. The official API still exposes no alliance field (verified 2 September 2026), so the in-game record remains readable only through such tooling.

## Sources

- Official Wynncraft Wiki, 'Version 2.2.1' (released 12 Jun 2026): 'Guild Allies can now do Guild Raids together'
- Official Wynncraft Wiki, 'Version 2.2.2' (released 10 Jul 2026): contains no ally-raid change (conflict with the chronicle noted above)
- Official Wynncraft Wiki, 'Guild War': ally taxation
- SequoiaWynncraft/Sequoia-mod repository: commit 69fb472 (12 Jun 2026, alliance-event parsing with captured fixtures); commit 8b27368 and Modrinth 1.8.0 changelog (30 Jul 2026, Diplomacy-menu snapshots)
- Official Wynncraft API v3/guild (checked 2 Sep 2026): no alliance field

articles.title: The Economy Update
articles.summary: Wynncraft version 1.18, the Economy Update, released 18 January 2019: professions, crafting and an in-game trade market. It reshaped the economy that funded guilds but left war mechanics essentially untouched.

infobox.label: Focus
infobox.value: Professions (gathering and crafting), trade market, guild banners

articles.body:
Version 1.18, officially titled 'The Economy Update', was released on 18 January 2019 — between the [[the-federation-dies|Federation's fall]] and the founding of [[Luna]], in the middle of [[the-alliance-wars-of-2019|the alliance wars of 2019]].

Its focus was the player economy rather than warfare: it introduced the professions system (gathering and crafting), and the official announcement promised an in-game trade market ('You'll be able to purchase/sell anything easily'). On the guild side its recorded contribution is cosmetic — guild banners were introduced in 1.18, replacing what the wiki calls 'the Mysterious Potatoes riddle'.

None of the sources consulted record changes to the guild war system itself in 1.18. The economy-and-war rework that transformed [[territory-warfare|territory warfare]] — war towers, guild resource production, trade routes and taxation — came two years later, in version 1.20 'Gavel Reborn' (20 January 2021), which also laid the groundwork for [[guild-seasons|Guild seasons]] and the in-game ally system (see [[the-diplomacy-update|The Diplomacy update]]).

articles.title: The Guild Update
articles.summary: Guilds and guild wars were introduced to Wynncraft in version 1.13, the Wynnter Update, released on 22 December 2014 — the starting point of all guild warfare history.
articles.body:
Guilds were introduced to Wynncraft in version 1.13 — the 'Wynnter Update' — released on 22 December 2014, and guild wars have existed since the same update. Per the official wiki, guilds 'were originally going to just be permanent parties'; instead they became territorial powers, and the war system introduced here is the one under which the entire [[early-guild-era|early guild era]] and [[federation-era|Federation era]] were fought.

In the original system, players accessed the Guild Master through a teleporter in Troms (moved to the Guild Hall in the 1.14 Gavel expansion of 2015). The 1.13-era war mechanics — including mob-wave wars fought on dedicated war servers, with territories generating XP — survived with incremental changes for six years, until the ground-up rework in version 1.20 'Gavel Reborn' (20 January 2021; see [[territory-warfare|Territory warfare]] and [[guild-seasons|Guild seasons]]).

Every era article on this wiki descends from this update: the first territorial powers of 2015–2016, the [[HackForums]] dominance, and everything after (see [[history-of-wynncraft-guild-warfare|History of Wynncraft guild warfare]]).
